1400: Veda avdin shiva yomin. mikkan ulehala, hahu lishana mechashkesha befuma dehahu tzippara, nakdin lehahu lishana bemachata dedahava, vehi memallela ravrevan miggarmah, vecholla hava yada balak betzippor da (vadday). al da ben tzippor, uvegin kach chama, ma debar nash achara la yachil leminda, vela yachil lemecheme. 40

Ketiv (Tehillim 68:23) amar Adonai mibbashan ashiv ashiv mimmetzulot yam. it lan leshavvava libba limhemnuta dekudesha berich hu, dechol milloy mille keshot, umehemnuta saggi. dechevan demilla amar, kolla itavid, veda bar nash dachik libba, veamar lechamma shenin, ulechama zimnin yishtelim da, deihu kach. kefum ravrevanu dileh, dechol almin malya yekareh, hachi hu. milloy bar nash zeer, vechol milloy innun lefum shaata, hachi hu lefum shaata. aval betiyyuveta, uvauta, uveovadin tavin, uvedimin saggiin, ihu kaddisha rav veillaa al kol alma, azhir nehoreh, vekamit kedushateh, legabbeh debar nash, lemebad reuteh.

Amar Adonai, lezimna deate, zammin kudesha berich hu leatteara uleatava mibbashan, kol innun dekatlu lon chevat bara veachlu lon. begin deit bealma (sefer acher uf hacha melech habbashan) atar motva, dechol chevan ravrevan, veturin ramain vesaggiin, utemirin illen beillen. vearod madbera takkifa tamman, ihu og (ben) arode demadbera hava, ushechiach tamman tukepa dileh, begin dehava melech habbashan, dechol malche alma, la yachlin leaggacha kerava beh, begin tukepa devashan. veata moshe, veagach beh kerava.

Sichon: sayycha demadbera hava sichon. verachtzanu demoav aleh hava. ki arnon gevul moav ben moav uven haemori. ta chaze, beshaata decharivu yisrael karta desichon, karoza itabbar bemalchu dishmayya, itkenashu guvrin shaltanin al shear ammin, vetechemun malchu deemoraa hech itcharav bemalchu.

Behahi shaata, kol innun shaltanin dahavo memanin al sheva amamin itkenashu, uvau leahaddara malchu leyoshnah. kevan dechamu tukpa demoshe, ahadru laachora. hada hu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 21:27) al ken yomru hammoshlim bou cheshbon, innun shiltonin memanan alayyhu deitkenashu, vahavu amre bou cheshbon, man hu den dechariv lah. tibbane vetikkonen kidbekadmeta, vetehdar malchu leyoshnah.

Kad chamu gevureta demoshe, veshalhova demalchu, amru ki esh yatza mecheshbon lehava mikkiryat sichon. kevan dichtiv mecheshbon, amay mikkiryat sichon. deha kiryat sichon cheshbon hava, dichtiv ki cheshbon ir sichon melech haemori.

Ella, shalhova demalka shemaya nafak, vechariv kolla. beshaata deinnun amrin tibbane vetikkonen ir sichon setam, vela amru cheshbon, dechashivu divgin kach yitbene lemotava deemoraa, keden ativu veamru, la yachilna. may tama. begin dechol archin ushevilin istatamu betukpa derav illaa dilhon. i nehdar venemma venidkar cheshbon detibbane, ha esh yatza mecheshbon. i nehdar venema (setam) kiryat sichon, ha lehava yatza mikkiryat sichon vadday. kevan dehahi shalhova deeshsha sharya tamman alah, let man deyachil lah leahdara lah leyoshnah, deha mikkol sitrin let lan reshu.
Mikkan ulehala oy lecha moav, deha hahu dehava magen alach, attebar. uvegin kach moav kevan dechamu demagen dilhon ittebar, keden vayyagar moav mippene haam meod. may meod, yattir mimmota.

Ki rav hu. deha keden ihu hava rav, verav hava zeer, dichtiv (Ovadya 1:2) hinne katon netatticha baggoyim. veyisrael hava rav baatar esav, dichtiv beh verav. may tama. begin dechamu deshaltu yisrael, ella vetatta. dichtiv et kol asher asa yisrael laemori. asher asa yisrael mibbae leh, may et kol. leasgaa ella vetatta, ella, deafillu mishshaltanehon ravrevin veshaltanin dilella. vaafillu mishshaltanehon ravrevanin veshaltanin diltatta. veal da et kol asher asa. veal da ki rav hu, baatar derav buchera kaddisha, dichtiv, (Shemot 4) beni vechori yisrael.
Vei tema dekudesha berich hu baa hachi, velav min dina. ta chaze, esav kelifa hava, vesitra achara hava. kevan
1401: Denafak kelifa veitavar, ha mocha shechicha (shifcha), arla kadmaa kae levar. berit ihu (sefer acher rav veillaa) yakkira mikkolla, veihu itgele levatar.

(Bamidbar 22:4) vayyomer moav el zikne midyan atta yelachachu vegomer. ribbi chiyyay patach, (Zecharya 3:1) vayyareni et yehoshua hakkohen haggadol omed lifne malach Adonai vegomer. kama it leh lebar nash, leistammera orchoy behay alma, ulemehach beorach keshot. begin dechol ovadoy debar nash ketivin kamme malka, ureshimin kammeh, vechullehu beminyayna. neture tare kayymin vesahadin, kayyme vetave dina terisin. vedayyayna kayyeyma lekabbela sahaduta, veinnun detaanu taanta merachshan, vela yedia i yehachun mimina, veim yismaalun missemala.

Deha kad ruche bene nasha nafke mehay alma, kama innun mekatregin dekayymin kammayyhu, vecharozin nafkin hen letav hen levish, kefum ma denafik min dina. detanya, bechamma dinin ittedan bar nash behay alma, ben bechayyyoy, ben levatar. deha kol milloy bedina innun. vekudesha berich hu tadir berachamanu, verachamoy al kolla, vela bae ledayyayna bene nasha kefum ovadehon, dehachi amar david, (Tehillim 130:3) im avonot tishmor yah Adonai mi yaamod. hacha it leistakkela, kevan deamar im avonot tishmor yah, amay Adonai (davar acher adonay).

Ella, telat dargin derachame adkar david hacha. im avonot tishmor yah, im chovin sagiu, ad desallekin leella legabbe abba veimma, ha Adonai (davar acher adonay) deihu rachame. vei shema da, af al gav deihu rachame, yittear bedina vechol dargin astimu bedina, darga chada it denehdar legabbeh, dechol asvavtin minne nafkin, ihu yachos alan, uman ihu, mi. mi yaamod vadday. mi yirpa lach. (kema deat amar 1 ki gadol kayyam shebberech mi yerappe lecha) veal da yah Adonai (davar acher adonay) i illen shemahan yistemun minan, mi yaamod, dechol orchin detiuveta petichan minneh.

Ta chaze, yehoshua ben yehotzadak tzaddik gamur hava, gavra dehava al lifnay lifnim, deayyluhv limtivta dirkia. itkenashu kol bene metivta tamman, leayyeyna bedineh. vechach archoy dehahu metivta dirkia, kad ayyle leh ledina, karoza nafik veachriz, kol bene metivta ulu leiddara temira, uve dina mitkanneshe.

Vehahu rucha devar nash salleka al yede ditre memanan, kevan deal, kariv legabbe chad ammuda deshalhova melahata dekayyeyma tamman, 40 veaggelim berucha daavira denashiv behahu ammuda, vechamma innun desallekin lon tamman. 40. begin dechol innun demishtaddele beorayyta, umechaddeshe bah chiddushin, miyyad achtuv legabbe bene 40 metivta innun millin, keden kol innun bene metivta atan lemechome leh. innun teren memanan nafkin, vesallekin leh lehahu metivta dirkia, miyyad kariv legabbe hahu ammuda, deaglim tamman.

Al limtivta, vechaman leh. i milla kaddeka yaut zakkaa ihu, kama itrin menatztzan, meatterin leh kol bene metivta. vei milla achara hava, vavy leh lehahu kissufa, dachyayn leh levar, vekaim go ammuda, ad deayyle leh ledina, rachamana lishezvan.

Veit acharanin desallekin lon tamman, kad kudesha berich hu biflugeta bivne metivta, veamre man mochach, ha peloni deochach milla. keden sallekin leh tamman, veochach hahu milla ben kudesha berich hu uven bene metivta. veit acharanin desallekin lon tamman ledina, vedayynin leh tamman, levarra lon, ulelabbena lon.

Amar leh ribbi yose, i hachi bela dina itpetar bar nash veistallak mehay alma. vei bedina istallak, amay ittedan zimna acharina. amar leh, hachi olifna, vehachi shemana, deha vadday bedina istallak bar nash mehay alma, aval ad la yeul limchitzathon detzaddikayya, salke leh ledina, vetamman ittedan behahu metivta dirkia.

Vetamman kayyeyma hahu memana degehinnam leastaa. zakkaa ihu man dezache min dina, vei lav hahu memana degehinnam natil leh, beshaata demasrin leh bidoy, umikla leh mittamman letatta, keman demikla avna
1402: Bekartifa (sefer acher bekusefita) dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 25:29) veet nefesh oyvecha yekalenna betoch kaf hakkala vegomer. veshadde leh legehinam, vekabbil onsheh kefum ma deitdan.

Ta chaze, (Zecharya 3:1) vayyareni et yehoshua hakkohen haggadol omed lifne malach vegomer, desaliku leh ledina, go hahu metivta dirkia, beshaata deitpetar mehay alma. omed lifne malach Adonai, da hu hahu naar, resh metivta, deihu chatich dina al kolla.

Vehassatan, man vehassatan. hahu dimmana, al nafshata begehinnam, detiuvete lemesav leh, vetadir kayyeyma veamar hav hav, havu chayyayvin legehinam. lesitno, leadkera chovoy. keden vayyomer Adonai el hassatan yigar becha hassatan veyigar Adonai becha, teren gearot amay. ella chad leduma. vechad, lehahu denafka miggehinnam, dekayyeyma tadir leastaa.

Ta chaze, hahu satan illaa nachit kema deukemuha, deaglim bediyyukena deshor, vechol innun ruchin bishin, deittedanu leaala bagehinnam, lachich lon beriga chada, vechataf lon, venachit veyahav lon leduma, levatar devala lon. veda hu dichtiv, vayyomer moav el zikne midyan atta yelachachu hakkahal et kol sevivotenu kilchoch hashshor, deishtemoda, hashshor dekayyeyma levish al kol bene alma. et yerek hassade, innun ruchin divne nasha, deinnun yerek hassade. hassade, hahu sade deishtemoda.

Amar ribbi yose, i hachi, chakkim hava balak. amar leh vadday, vehachi itzterich leh leminda kol archoy dehahu shor, vei la yade lehu, la yachil lemebad charashoy vekismoy. amar ribbi yose vadday hachi hu, veyaut amart. vetukepeh dehahu shor, mikki machrizu al hattevua. (kan chaser) kol innun yomin demachrizin vechol yomin demachrize al ruchehon divne nasha. veinnun (196 amud bet, Rabbi elazar vechulei shayych kan) yome nisan, veyome tishre, veha ittemar. Ribbi yitzchak veribbi yehuda havo azle beorcha, matu lehahu atar dichfar sichnin, dehava tamman rav hamenuna sava, itarachu beitteta dileh, dehava lah bera chada zeera, vechol yoma hava beve sifra, hahu yoma salik mibbe sifra, veata leveta, chama lon leillen chakkimin. amar leh immeh, kariv legabbe illen guverin illain vetirvavch minnayyhu birchaan. kariv legabbayyhu, ad la kariv, ahadar laachora. amar leh leimmeh, la baena lekarva legabbayyhu. deha yoma da la karu keriat shema, vehachi olfe li, kol man dela kare keriat shema beonateh, benidduy hu kol hahu yoma.

Shamu innun, vetavvevhu, arimu yedayyhu uvarichu leh. amru vadday hachi hu. veyoma da ishtaddalna bahade chatan vechalla, dela hava lon tzarchayyhu, vahavu mitacharan leizdavvevga, vela hava bar nash leishtaddela alayyhu, vaanan ishtaddallena behu, vela karenan keriat shema beonateh, uman deitassak bammitzva, patur min hamitzva. amru leh, beri, bema yadat. amar leh, berecha dilvushayychu yedana, kad karivna legabbayychu. tavvhu. yatvu, natlu yedayyhu vecharichu rifta.

Ribbi yehuda havo yedoy meluchelchan, venatil yedoy, uvarich ad la natil. amar leh, i talmide derav shemaya chasida attun, la hava lechu levarcha beyadayim mezuhamot, uman devarich beyadayim mezuhamot, chayyayv mita.

Patach hahu yannuka veamar, (Shemot 30:20) bevoam el ohel moed yirchatzu mayim velo yamutu vegomer. yalfenan mehay kera, deman dela chayish lehay, veyitchaze kamme malka bidin mezuhaman, chayyayv mita. may tama. begin didoy debar nash yatvin berumu shel olam. etzbea chada it bida debar nash, veihu etzbea dearama moshe.

Ketiv (sham 26) veasita verichim atze shittim chamishsha lekarshe tzela hammishkan haechad vachamishsha verichim lekarshe tzela hammishkan hashshenit. uchetiv vehabberiach hattichon betoch hakkerashim mavriach min hakkatze el hakkatze. vei tema, dehahu bariach hattichon achara hu, dela hava bichlala deinnun chamishsha. lav hachi. ella hahu beriach hattichon, meinnun chamishsha hava. teren mikkan, uteren mikkan, vechad beemtzaita. ha hava beriach hattichon, ammuda deyaakov, raza demoshe,
1403: Lokovel da, chamesh etzbean bida devar nash. vehabberiach hattichon beemtzaita, rav veillaa mikkolla, beh kayymin shear acharanin.

Veinnun chamesh berichin, deikrun chamesh mea shenin, deilana dechayye azil behu. uverit kadisha itar (sefer acher itgezar), bechamesh etzbean diyda. umilla (nusach acher setima) tema hu al ma deamrat. veal da kol birchan dechahana, beetzbean talyayn. ferisu diyda demoshe al da hava.

I kol da it behu, let dina lemehevi benakyu, kad mevarchin behu lekudesha berich hu. begin divhu, uvedugema dilhon, mitberach shema kadisha. veal da attun dechachmittu tuva, hech la ashgachtun lehay. vela shemashtun leribbi shemaya chasida, veihu amar, kol tinnufa, vechol lichlucha, seliku leh lesitra achara, deha sitra achara mehay tinnufa velichlucha itzan. (teruma 154 amud bet) veal da mayim acharonim chova, vechova innun.

Tavvhu vela yachilu lemallela. amar ribbi yehuda, beri, shema deavuch man hu. shatik yannuka riga chada, kam legabbeh immeh venashak lah, amar leh immi, al abba shailu li illen chakkimin, ema lon. amar leh immeh, beri, badkat lehu. amar ha badakit, vela ashkachit kaddeka yaut. lechisha leh immeh, veahdar legabbayyhu, amar leh attun sheeltun al abba, veha istellak mealma, uvechol yoma dechaside kadishin azlin bearcha, ihu tayyaya abbatrayyhu. vei attun kaddishe elyonin, hech la ashchachtun leh, azil tayyaya abbatrayychu.

Aval bekadmita chamena bechu, vehasheta chamena bechu, deabba la chama chamara dela (sefer acher deleheve) tain avatreh chamara, lemisbal ula deorayyta. kevan dela zechittun deabba yatun abbatrayychu, la emma man hu abba. amar ribbi yehuda leribbi yitzchak, kiddame lan, hay yannuka lav bar nash hu. achlu. vehahu yenoka hava amar mille deorayyta, vechiddushe orayyta. amru, hav venivrich. amar lehu, yaut amartun. begin dishma kaddisha la mitberach bivracha da, ella behazemana.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 34:2) avarcha et Adonai bechol et vegomer. vechi ma chama david lomar avarcha et Adonai. ella, chama david devae hazemana, veamar avarcha. begin divshaata devar nash yativ al patora, shechinta kayyeyma tamman, vesitra achara kayyeyma tamman. kad azmin bar nash levarcha lekudesha berich hu, shechinta ittekkanat (nusach acher bahazemana da) legabbe ella, lekabbela birchan, vesitra achara itkafyay. (nusach acher vei ittaknat bevirchata legabbe ella, vesitra achara lav ihu bichlala) vei la azmin bar nash levarcha lekudesha berich hu, sitra achara shomea umechashkesha lemehevi leh chulaka behahi beracha.

Vei tema, bishar birchan amay la it hazemana. ella hahu milla divracha, deka mevarchin alah, ihu hazemana. veta chaze dehachi hu, dehay dimvarech al peri, hahu peri ihu hazemana, umevarchin aleh. velet leh chulaka lesitra achara. vekodem da, dehava hahu peri birshut desitra achara, la mevarchin aleh. uchetiv (Vayikra 19) lo yeachel, begin dela yevarchun al hahu peri, vela yitberach sitra achara. kevan denafak mershuteh, yeachel, umevarchin aleh. veihu hazemana levirchata. vechen kol millin dealma deka mevarchin alayyhu. kullehu hazemana levirchata. velet behu chulaka lesitra achara.

Vei tema, uf hachi levirkat zimmun kassa devirchata hava hazemana, amay hav venivrich. ella, hoil uvekadmeta kad hava shate, amar bore peri haggefen. ha hazemana havi. vehasheta levirkat mezona, baenan shinnuy, lehazemana achara, deha kassa da lekudesha berich hu havi, velav limzona, uvegin kach bae hazemana defuma.

Vei tema, nevarech sheachalnu mishshelo, da hu hazemana, baruch sheachalnu da hu beracha. hachi hu vadday. aval nevarech, hazemana achara ihu, hazemana devore peri haggefen. (sefer acher defuma) dekadmeta ihi hazemana lechos divracha setam. vehay kos, kevan deantil ihu hazemana achara bemilla dinvarech legabbe alma illaa dechol mezonin uvirchan mittamman nafkin, uvegin kach ihu beorach satim, dealma illaa satim ihu, velet legabbeh hazemana. ella bedarga da kos divracha. (bemilla danebarech) amar ribbi yehuda, zakkaa chulakana, demin

Amar leh, bera, malacha daAdonai, rechima dileh, hay deamrat veasita verichim atze shittim chamishsha lekarshe tzela hammishkan vegomer, vachamishsha verichim vegomer, vachamishsha verichim layarchatayim yamma. ha berichim tuva ikka hacha, veyadayim innun teren. amar leh, da hu deamrin, mippumeh devar nash ishtema man ihu. aval hoil vela ashgachtun ana ema.

Patach veamar, (Kohelet 2:14) hechacham enav berosho vegomer. vechi bean atar enoy debar nash, ella berosho, dilma begufo o bidroeh, deappik lechacham yatir michol bene alma. ella kera hachi hu vadday, ditnan, la yehach bar nash begiluy deresha 4 ammot. may tama. dishchinta sharya al resheh, vechol chakkim, enoy umilloy berosho innun, behahu desharya vekayyeyma al resheh.

Vechad enoy tamman, linda dehahu nehora deadlik al resheh, itzterich lemishcha, begin degufa debar nash ihu petila, unehora adlik leella, ushelomo malka tzavavch veamar, (Kohelet 9:8) veshemen al roshcha al yechsar, deha nehora divrosho, itzterich lemishcha veinnun ovadin tavan. veal da hechacham enav berosho, vela baatar achara.

Attun chakkimin, vadday shechinta sharyay al reshayychu, hech la ashgachtun lehay, dichtiv veasita verichim vegomer, lekarshe tzela hammishkan haechad. vachamishsha berichim lekarshe tzela hammishkan hashshenit. haechad vehashshenit amar kera, shelishit ureviit la amar kera. deha echad veshenit, da chashivu ditren sitrin, uvegin kach avid chushevana bitren illen.

Atu innun uneshakuhu, (kemillekaddemin) bacha ribbi yehuda, veamar, ribbi shimon zakkaa chulakach, zakkaa dara, deha bizchutach afillu yannuke deve rav, innun tinarin ramain takkifin. atat immeh, amra lon rabbotay, bematu minnayychu, la tishgechun al beri, ella beena tava. amru lah, zakkaa chulakach itteta keshera, itteta berira mikkol shear nashin, deha kudesha berich hu barir chulakach, vearim diglach al kol shear nashin dealma.

Amar yannuka, ana la mistafena meena bisha, devar nuna rabba veyakkira ana, venuna la dachil meena bisha, dichtiv, (Bereshit 48:16) veyidgu larov bekkerev haaretz, may larov, leasgaa al ena. vetanenan, ma dagim deyamma, mayya chappe alehon, velet ena bisha vechulei. larov vadday, bekerev haaretz, bego bene enasha al ara. amru, bera, malacha daAdonai, let bana ena bisha, vela missitra deena bisha atenan. vekudesha berich hu chappe alach begadpoy.

Patach veamar (Bereshit 48:16) hammalach haggoel oti mikkol ra yevarech vegomer. hay kera amar yaakov beruach kudesha, i beruach kudesha amar leh, raza dechachmeta it beh. hammalach, kare leh malach. vekare leh shemahan acharanin. hacha, amay ikre malach. ella kad ihu shelicha milleella, vekabbilat zohara miggo aspaklarya dilella, (sefer acher dechad) dichden mevarchin abba veimma lehay, amre lah beratti, zili neturi betech, pekidi levetech. hachi avidi levetech. zili vezuni lon. zili, dehahu alma diltatta mechakka lach, bene betcha mechakkan mezona minach, ha lach kol ma detitztarchi lemehav lon, keden ihi malach.

Vei tema, veha bechamma duchete ikre malach, vela ate lemezan almin. veod, devishma da la zan almin, ella bishma daAdonai. hachi hu vadday, kad shaliach miggo abba veimma, ikre malach, vechevan deshari al duchetin, al teren keruvin adonay shemeh.

Lemoshe kad itchaze leh bekadmita, ikre (Bereshit 113 amud bet) (Shemot 3) malach. leyaakov la itchaze hachi, ella bedugema, dichtiv (Bereshit 29:9) verachel baa, da diyyukena derachel achara, dichtiv (Yirmeyahu 31:15) ko amar Adonai kol berama nishma vegomer. rachel mevakka al baneha. verachel baa setam, im hatztzon dargin dilah. asher leaviha vday. vechullehu itmenun veitpakkedun bidaha. ki roa hi, ihi manhiga lon, veitpakkeda alayyhu.
1405: Bemoshe ketiv, (Shemot 3:2) vayyera malach Adonai elav belabbat esh. vei tema yatir hu shevacha deavraham, dela ketiv beh malach, ella (Bereshit 18:1) vayyera elav Adonai beelone mamre vegomer. hatam beavraham, itchaze leh adonay, bealef dalet, begin divhahu zimna kabbil berit, uma dehava itkasse ad kean minneh, itchaze leh ribbon veshalit, vehachi itchaze, deha keden behahu darga itkashar, vela yatir. uvegin kach, bishma daadon ribbon aleh.

Aval moshe dela hava beh piruda, dichtiv (Shemot 3:4) moshe moshe dela paska taama. kema dichtiv (Bereshit 22:11) avraham avraham, defaska taama. begin dehashta shelim, ma dela hava mikkadmat dena. perishu it ben avraham dehashta, leavraham dekadmeta. aval moshe, miyyad deityeylid, aspaklaryaa denahara havat immeh, dichtiv (Shemot 2:25) vattere oto ki tov hu. uchetiv (Bereshit 1:4) vayyar elohim et haor ki tov. moshe miyyad itkeshar bedarga dileh uvegin kach moshe moshe, vela afsik taama.

Veal da legabbe demoshe, azir garmeh, dichtiv malach Adonai. yaakov kara leh, beshaata dehava salik mealma, malach. may tama. begin divhahi shaata hava yarit lah, leshalletaa. moshe bechayav. yaakov, levatar desalik mealma. moshe begufa. yaakov berucha. zakkaa chulaka demoshe.

Haggoel oti mikkol ra, dela itkeriv lealmin legabbe sitra dera, vela yachil ra leshalletaa beh. yevarech et hannearim, keden yaakov hava metakken leveteh, kebar nash deazil leveta chadta, umetakken lah betikkunoy, umekashshet lah bekishutoy. yevarech et hannearim, innun deishtemodan, innun deitpakdan al alma, leitmashshecha minnayyhu birchan, teren keruvin innun. veyikkare vahem shemi, hasheta atkin beteh, veihu istallak bedargeh, begin dechibbura beyaakov havi. gufa, itdevak baatar deitzterich, uteren deroin bahadeh.

Levatar deinnun nearim mitbarchan kaddeka yaut, keden veyidgu larov bekerev haaretz. archa denunin leasgaa go mayin, vei nafkan miggo mayya leyabbeshta, miyyad metin. illen lav hachi, ella innun min yamma rabba, usegiu dilhon leafasha uleasge bekkerev haaretz ihu. ma delet hachi lechol nunin dealma.

Ma ketiv leella, vayvarech et yosef vayyomar, vela ashkechan leh hacha birchan, deha levatar barich leh, dichtiv, (Bereshit 49:22) ben porat yosef. ella, kevan devarich leillen nearim, leyosef berich. deha la yachli leitbarcha, ela migo yosef, umigo deihu bitmiru, vela itchaze leitgallaa, ketiv bitmiru, veyikare vahem shemi veshem avotay, (lechassaa aleh) min haavot mitvarchan, vela meatar achara. bekerev haaretz, da hu kissuya lechoppaa ma deitzterich.

Atu uneshaku kemillekaddemin, amru, havu venivrich. amar ihu, ani avarech, dechol ma dishmatun ad hacha minnay hava, vaakayyem bi (Mishlei 22:9) tov ayin hu yevorach, kare beh yevarech. may tama. begin denatan millachmo laddal. millachma umechla deorayyta dili achaltun. amar ribbi yehuda. bera rechima dekudesha berich hu, ha tanenan baal habbayit botzea veoreach mevarech. amar leh, lav ana baal habbayit, velav attun orchin. aval kera ashkachna, vaakayyem leh. deha ana tov ayin vadday, bela shailu dilchon amena ad hasheta, velachma umechla dili achaltun.

Natal kassa devirchata uvarich, vidoy la yachle lemisbal kassa, vahavu meratte. kad mata leal haaretz veal hammazon, amar, (Tehillim 116:13) kos yeshuot essa uveshem Adonai ekra. kayyeyma kassa al tikkuneh, veityeshshav biymineh, uvarich. lesof amar, yehe raava dilchad meillen, yitmashshechun leh chayyin, miggo (nusach acher malka) ilana dechayye, dechol chayyin beh talyayn. vekudesha berich hu yeerav leh, veyishkach arev letatta, deyistakkam bearvuteh, bahade malka kadisha.
Kevan devarich, astim enoy riga chada, levatar patach lon, amar chavrayyay, shelom lechon meribbon tav, dechol alma dileh hu. tavvhu, uvachu, uvarichu leh. battu hahu lelya. betzafra
1406: Akdimu veazlu. kad matu legabbe rabbi shimon, sachu leh ovada. tavva ribbi shimon, amar bar tinara takkifa ihu, veyaut hu lechach, veyatir mimma dela chashiv bar nash, bereh derav hamenuna sava hu, izdaza ribbi elazar, amar, alay lemehach lemecheze lehahu botzina dedalik. amar ribbi shimon, da la salik bishma bealma, deha milla illaa it beh. veraza ihu, deha nehiru meshicho (meshichu) daavoy menahara aleh, veraza da la mitpashsheta ben chavrayyay.

Yoma chada, havo chavrayyay yatvin umitnaggechin illen beillen, vahavu tamman ribbi elazar, veribbi abba, veribbi chiyyay, veribbi yose, ushear chavrayyay. amru ha ketiv (Devarim 2:9) al tatzar et moav veal titgar bam milchama vegomer. begin rut venaama, dahavo zeminin lenafka minnayyhu. tzifora ittat moshe dahavat mimmidyan, veyitro uvenoy denafku mimmidyan, dahavo kullehu zakkae keshot al achat kamma vechamma. vetu moshe derabbiu leh bemidyan, veamar leh kudesha berich hu, (Bamidbar 31:2) nekom nikmat bene yisrael meet hammidyanim i hachi masso panim it bemilla, deyatir itchazu bene midyan leshezava min moav.

Amar ribbi shimon, la dame man dezammin lemilkat teene, leman dichvar lakit lon. amar leh ribbi elazar, af al gav dichvar lakit lon, shevacha ihu. amar leh, man dela lakat teene, natir teena tadir, dela yehe bah pegam, begin teene dizminat leayytaa. kevan delakit teene, shavik lah latteena, vetu la natir lah.

Kach moav, dizmina leayytaa innun teene, natar leh kudesha berich hu, dichtiv al tatzar et moav. midyan deka yehivat teene, vealkitu lon, ketiv (Bamidbar 25:17) tzaror et hammidyanim. deha mikkan ulehala, teena da la zeminat leayytaa perin, uvegin kach itchazyayt likidat eshsha. patach veamar, (Bamidbar 22:4) vayyomer moav el zikne midyan vegomer, moav innun share, uvegin innun teene, dezammin moav leappaka lealma, ishtezivu meonsha.

Ribbi elazar baa lemechome leribbi yose beribbi shimon ben lakuneya chamuy. vahavu azle ribbi abba veribbi yose (davar acher lo garsinan verabbi chiyyay) bahadeh, azlu bearcha, vahavu amre mille deorayyta kol hahu archa.

Amar ribbi abba, may dichtiv, vayomer Adonai elay al tatzar et moav veal titgar bam milchama vegomer, uchetiv (Devarim 2:19) vekaravta mul bene ammon vegomer, milla da kemila da, ma hefresh ben da leda, ella itchaze dishkule havo. vetanenan, kad havo mekarve legabbe bene moav, havo yisrael itchazyayn legabbayyhu bechol mane kerava, (velo sefer acher 33) kidbau itgaryayn behu. ulegabbe bene ammon, havo yisrael mitattefe beittufayyhu, vela itchaze mane kerava kelal. ukeran mochachan beshikkula da keda.

Amar ribbi elazar, vday hachi hu. vetanenan, deda dahavat chatzifa, veamrat moav, dichtiv, (Bereshit 19:37) vattikra et shemo moav. itchazun yisrael chatzifu legabbayyhu, kema deihi havat chatzifa, deamrat moav, meav hava bera da. aval zeerta, deamrat ben ammi, vechassiat archaha, yisrael havo mechasseyayn archayyhu legabbayyhu, meatfe ittufa betalit, veitchazun kammayyhu keachin mammash. veha ukemuha.

Ad dahavo azle, idkar ribbi elazar mehay yannuka, satu mearcha 3 parse, umatu lehatam. itarachu behahu beta, alu veashkachu lehahu yannuka, dehava yetiv, umetakkenin patora kammeh. kevan dechama lon, kariv gabbayyhu, amar leh, ulu chaside kadishin, ulu shetilin dealma, innun deella vetatta meshabbechin lon. innun deafillu nune yamma rabba, nafkin beyabbeshta legabbayyhu. ata ribbi elazar uneshakeh beresheh. hadar kemillekaddemin, uneshakeh befumeh. amar ribbi elazar neshika kadmaa al nunin deshavkin mayya, veazlin beyabbeshta. uneshika tinyayna al biin denuna, deavdu iva tava bealma.
Amar hahu yannuka, berecha dilvushayychu chamena, deammon umoav mitgaran bechu, hech ishtezevtun minnayyhu. mane kerava la havo bidayychu. vei lav, lerachtzanu tehachun, bela dechilu.
1407: Tavvhu ribbi elazar veribbi abba vechavrayyay. amar ribbi abba, zakkaa archa da, vezakkaa chulakana dezachena lemechome da, atkinu patora kemillekaddemin.

Amar, chakkimin kadishin. tivu nahama detafnuke bela kerava, (sefer acher o nahama dikrava ufatora demane kerava). o fatora demane kerava. o nahama dikrava. o tivun levarcha lemalka bechol mane kerava deha patora la istalik bela kerava. amar ribbi elazar, bera rechima chaviva kadisha, hachi baenan, bechol hane zine kerava ishtaddalna behu, veyadenan leagacha becharba, uvekashta, uveromcha, uveavanin dekirta. veant ravya, ad la chamit, hech magichin kerava, guverin takkifin dealma.

Chadde hahu yannuka, amar vadday la chamena, aval ketiv (Melachim 1 20:11) al yithallel choger kimfatteach. atkinu patora benahama, uvechol ma deitzterich. amar ribbi elazar, kama chedu it belibbai beravya da, vechama chiddushin yitchaddeshun al patora da, veal da amarit, deyadana dezage pamone rucha kadisha, havo azlin beh.

Amar hahu yannuka, man devae lenahama, al pum charba yechul. chadde ribbi elazar, ahdar vekariv yannuka legabbeh, amar leh, begin deshavchat garmach, it lach lemegach kerava bekadmita, vaana amarit bekadmita, dikrava lihevi batar achila. aval hasheta, man devae solta, tole (nusach acher yete) mane kerava bidoy. amar ribbi elazar, lach yeot leachazaa meinnun mane kerava dilach.

Patach hahu yannuka veamar, (Bamidbar 15:19) vehaya baachalchem millechem haaretz tarimu teruma laAdonai. kera da al omer hattenufa ittemar, may tenufa, i begin deanif leh kahana leella ihi tenufa. may ichpat lan, i anif i maich.

Ella vadday itzterich learma lah leella, vehayeynu teruma. veaf al gav dedarshenan tere mimmea, vehachi hu, aval tenufa may (sefer acher da) hu aramuta. veraza dechachmeta hacha. i chaside kadishin, mare deromchin, la shemashtun leribbi shemaya chasida, dei lav tindeun tenufa may hi. chitta may hi. seora may hi.

Tenufa dekaamrenan, hayeynu tenu pe. veraza dileh (Yirmeyahu 13:16) tenu kavod laAdonai elohechem. deha pe (illaa) hayeynu kavod, devaenan lemehav leh lekudesha berich hu. veal da ive lan learma leella, leachazaa (sefer acher delet inun yahavin ella lehay pe) dilleh anan yahavin lehay pe. delet shevacha lemalka illaa, ella kad yisrael metakkene leh lehay kavod, veyahave leh lemalka kavod. veda hu tenu pe, tenu kavod, vearama ihu vaday.

Kera desharenan beh, vehaya baachalchem millechem haaretz. vechi lachem haaretz seora ihu, lav hachi. vaanan seora mekarvenan, begin disora kadmaa lishar nahama dealma. seora ihu (sefer acher shiur hei, deha atar) seora deh yedia hu, beshiura dehe. (sefer acher chitta beHei nekuda vechulei) chitta nekuda beemtzaita, delet chulaka lesitra achara dechova tamman. (ella) chitta beratta demitchattea lekamme avuha, veavid lah reuta, uma chitta. kelala 26 atvavn.

Amar ribbi elazar, af al gav dehava lan lemishma. hacha it lan lememar, uledarcha kashta. amar hahu yannuka, ha maginna lokovel gira. amar ribbi elazar, vadday chitta hachi karenan lah. aval chamenan bashvatim kullehu delet behu chet, uvah it chet, vekarenan chitta. amar hahu yannuka, vadday hachi hu, deha chet sharya samich lah. behu beshivtin, la havo atvavn illen, deka atu missitra dikdushsha dilella, aval legabbah sharya.

Vei bait leappaka charba, vetema amay naktat atvavn illen hahi beratta, ella i tinda chova deadam harishon, deamru chitta hava, tinda ha. veilana da kad natzach, kolla sitra detov, nakit lechol sitra achara, vechafyay leh.

Chavrayyay kadmae perishu milla da, vesharu lah merachik, chitta setam. atu batrae veamru, chitta mammash. ata yeshaya ufarish lah, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 54:14) umimmechitta ki lo tikrav elayich, veal ken nekuda beemtzaita, dela yehe chattaa, deillu nekuda la havi, chattaa lehevi. vechillufa ben 9 let, taviru lesitra achara, beriru (sefer acher dilah) demila.
1408: Shemaya chasida, amrin divchameshet zine dagan, la it chulaka listar achara. velav hachi, deha kol ma deitbele beara, listar achara it beh chulaka. uman chulaka it leh. motz detiddefennu ruach, dichtiv, (Tehillim 1:4) lo chen harshaim ki im kamotz asher tiddefennu ruach. veda hu rucha dikdushsha, uchetiv (Tehillim 103:16) ki ruach avra bo veenennu vegomer. begin deruach kudsha mefazzer leh bechol sitrin dealma, dela yishtechach. da benukeba. dechura may hu. teven.

Umotz veteven kachada azlin, veal da patur mimmaaser. delet behu chulaka bikdusha. Adonai, dagan benakyu (dedagan) bela teven umotz. chet dechar venukeba, motz veteven, 5: benakyu dedagan. veal da shelimu deilana chitta ihu veilana dechata beh adam harishon chitta hava. decholla ihu beraza, uvemilla dechitta. (sefer acher bikdushsha Adonai nakeyv dedagan belo teven vamevatz veal da shelimu deilana chitta ihu vecholla ihu beraza dechitta) tavav ribbi elazar, vetavvevhu chavrayyay, amar ribbi elazar, vadday hachi hu.

Amar hahu yannuka, hachi hu vadday, kera desharenan beh, deha seora akdim lemete lealma. veihu mittakkan lemechla divira setam, ihu raza deelef harim, demgaddelin bechol yoma, vehi achla lon. veikre lechem teruma, mechla dehahu teruma, (sefer acher vaataketzar) veitkeriv belelya, deha ketiv (Vayikra 22:7) uva hashshemesh vetaher veachar yochal min hakkodashim ki lachmo hu. min hakkodashim da teruma. min hakkodashim, vela kodashim, deha kodesh setam la ikre teruma, dechomer bakkodesh mibbatruma tenan.

Ara kadisha birshu dekudesha berich hu havat, ureshu achara la al tamman. hech ivdikat ara, i kayymat bimhemnuta, vela itchabberat birshu achara, bikrivu ditruma da disorim, kegavvna deraza desota. amar ribbi ava, vadday shinnana decharba legabbach, amar hahu yannuka, vadday itakafna bemagen vetzina leaggana minneh. amar ribbi abba, ara kadisha let bah reshu achara, vela al tamman. motz veteven mimman havo.

Patach hahu yannuka veamar, (Bereshit 1:28) vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo vegomer. uchetiv vayyomer lahem elohim peru urevu. vechi i lav deata nachash al chavva la yavid (58 sefer acher amud alef) toladin lealma, o i la chavu yisrael beovada deegla, la yaavdun toladin. ella vadday, i la yete nachash al chavva, toladin yavid adam miyyad vadday, deha gezera itgezar miyyad deitbere, dichtiv peru urevu umilu et haaretz. veinnun toladin yehon kullehon binkiu bela zuhama kelal. uf hachi ara kadisha, deha la al bah reshu achara, it bah motz veteven, delav mehahu setar. ulevar meara, hahu motz veteven distar achara havi, deazla batar kedushsha, kekof batar bene nasha.

Atu ribbi elazar vechavrayyay uneshakuhu, amar leh, dame li, deravavchna bemane kerava, nahama defatora. amar ribbi elazar vday hachi hu, deha kol zine kerava bidach innun, umatzlichan bidach, atu uneshakuhu kemillekaddemin.

Patach ihu veamar, (Bereshit 40:10) uvaggefen shelosha sarigim vegomer. ad hacha chezyona demilla, deha mikkan ulehala chezyona dileh hava, dichtiv vechos paro beyadi. aval chezyona demilla, begineh deyosef hava ulevassera leh, deyishma yosef veyinda.

Tanenan, shiva rekiin innun, veinnun (shiva) hechalin. veshit innun, vachamesh innun, vechullehu nafke miggo yayin attika illaa. hahu yayin mashich leh yaakov merachik, vesachit leh meanavim dehahu gefen. keden, yaakov amshich leh hahu yayin deka itchaze leh, vechaddi veshata. (Bereshit 142 amud bet) hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 27:25) vayyave lo yayin vayyesht. hacha itkelil ella vetatta. veal da archik milla, umashich lah bimshichu ditre tenue, vehayeynu lo. leh letatta, leh leella. (bitren sitrin achid)

Chanoch metatron amar, vayyave lo yayin, dearme mayya behahu yayin, vei lav dearme beh mayim, la yachil lemisbal, veshappir amar chanoch metatron. uvegin kach amshich lo bitre taame, deha bitren sitrin achid, vehahu yayin azil middarga ledarga, vechullehu taamin beh, ad deyosef tzaddika taim leh, deihu david neeman, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 7:10) keyen hattov holech ledodi lemesharim.
1409: Mahu keyen hattov. deata yaakov vearme beh mayya, da hu yen hattov vehachi hu, kema deamar chanoch metatron. tavav ribbi elazar, vetavvav ribbi abba, amru ha chamra (70 malach) dilach, hu natzchat malacha kadisha, appuma (nusach acher puma) deruach kudesha.

Amar leh, ad kean hahu gefen mechakka lemebad perin. uvaggefen: da ihu gefen deishtemoda bekudesha. begin deit gefen achara, deihu ikre gefen nachriyya. vaanavim dilah la innun anavim, ella kashyan, achidin libba, nashchin kechalba. innun anavim ikrun, (Yirmeyahu 2:21) sure haggefen nachriyya. aval gefen da, alah ketiv uvaggefen, hahi deishtemoda. hahi dechol kadishin taamu chamra attika, chamra tava, chamra deyaakov yahiv beh mayya, ad dechol innun deyadin letama chamra, taamu leh, vahava tav lechikka.

Vehahi gefen, kad mata legabbah, oshitat telata sarigin, veinnun telat diyyukena daavahan, deitkaddeshat behu. velet kedushsha ella beyayin, velet birchata ella beyayin. baatar dechedva share. vehi cheforachat, kechalla deitkashshetat vealat birchimu, bechedva dehahu yayin deitarav bemayya. keden alta nitztzah, selikat rechimu dilah legabbe dodah, veshariat lenaggena uleaala birchimu. ucheden, itmalleyayn veitvashshelan innun anavin, rechichan, umalyayn mehahu chamra tava attika chamra deyaakov arme beh mayya.

Veal da man dimvarech al hayyayin, umate al haaretz, itzterich lemirme beh mayya, begin delet leh levarcha rachem Adonai al yisrael ammach, bar bemayya go chamra. vei lav, man yachil lemisbal. da hava levassera leyosef, begin deveh hava talya milleta.

Chanoch metatron amar, shelosha sarigim, vday. lokovel telat avahan, veha arba innun dilah. ella da hu dichtiv, vehi cheforachat. bezimna deihi selikat ufarchat bechanfaha lesalleka, keden alta nitztzah, da hu hahu reviaa deishtear, desalik bahadah, vela itperash minnah. hada hu dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 22:11) vayyirkav al keruv vayyaof. kad yaof. cheforachat, bezimna deforachat. veshappir amar chanoch metatron, vehacha hu.

Tavav ribbi elazar, vetavvav ribbi abba, amru, malacha kadisha, shelicha milleella, ha chamra dilach, hu, natzacht beraza deruach kudsha. atu kullehu chavrayyay uneshakuhu. amar ribbi elazar, berich rachamana deshadarni hacha.

Amar hahu yannuka, chavrayyay. nahama vechamra ikkara defatora innun, kol shear mechla abbatrayyhu itmeshach. veha orayyta ravvchat lon, vedilah innun. orayyta baat minnayychu, bevau, birchimu, veamra (Mishlei 9:Adonai) lechu lachamu belachmi ushetu beyayin masachti. vehoil veorayyta zeminat lechu, vehi baat minnayychu milla da, it lechu lemebad reuta dilah. (nusach acher hu) bematu minnayychu, hoil veihi zemina lechu, detaavdun reutah. amru hachi hu vday. yatvu veachlu vechadu bahadeh. kevan deachlu itakkevu al patora.

Patach ihu veamar. (Bamidbar 22:4) vayyomer moav el zikne midyan vegomer. vayyomru zikne moav veel zikne midyan la ketiv, ella vayyomer moav. ulemin natlu eta misavya, vesavya itmeshachu abbatrayyhu, veinnun yahavu lon eta. may eta yahavu lon. eta bisha natlu legarmayyhu. amru lon lemoav, giddula bisha giddalna benana. umano. moshe rabbehon. al chad kumara dehava benana, derave leh vegadil leh beveteh, veyahav leh beratteh leintu. velo od, ella yahav leh mamona, veshadar leh lemitzrayim, leshetzaa kol ara. veihu, vechol beteh, itmeshachu abbatreh. i lehahu rabbehon, nechul leakera min alma, kol amma dileh yitakkerun miyyad mealma. vechol eta bisha mehahu milla difor, mimmidyan hava.

Veta chaze, decholla hava mimmidyan. vechol eta dilhon al moshe hava. uveeta dilhon, sachru levilam. kevan dechamu devilam la yachil, natlu eta achara bisha legarmayyhu, veafkiru nashayyhu uvenatayyhu yatir mimmoav, deha al neshe midyan ketiv, (Bamidbar 31:16) hen henna hayu livne yisrael vegomer. vecholla mimmidyan hava. natlu
1410: Eta bahade nesia dilhon, deyafkir beratteh. dachashivu lenatla lemoshe berishtehon, bechamma zine charshin aatru lah, deyittafes resha dilhon. vekudesha berich hu (Yeshayahu 44:25) meshiv chachamim achor.

Innun chaman deresha yittafes berishta dilhon, vela yadu, chamu vela chamu. chamu resha deamma denafil bahadah, vechamma alfin ocharanin, vachashivu demoshe hava, afkiru lah, ufakidu lah al moshe, dela tizdavvevgi leachara, ella beh. amra lon, bema enda. amru hahu detechome decholla kayyme kammeh, beh tizdavvevgi, vela beachara. kevan deata zimri ben salu, kamu kameh arbea veesrim (nusach acher tisha vachamishshim) elef, mishshivta deshimon, begin dehava nesia dilhon, vehi chashivat dehu moshe, veizdavvevgat beh. kevan dechamu kol innun shear leda, avdu ma deavdu, vahava ma dehava.

Vecholla hava mimmidyan, bechamma zinin, uvegin kach itanashu midyan. vekudesha berich hu amar lemoshe, (Bamidbar 31:2) nekom nikmat bene yisrael meet hammidyanim. lach itchaze, velach yeot. lemoav ana shavik lon levatar deyippekun teren margelan minnayyhu, ha david bereh deyishay, deihu yinkom nukemin demoav, veyische kedera demalya tinnufa difor, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 60:10) moav sir rachtzi vadday, vead deinnun teren margelan la nafku, la itanashu, kevan denafku, ata david veasche kedera mittinnufa dilhon. vechullehu itanashu. midyan beyme moshe. moav bime david.

Ta chaze, chayyayvayya demiddin, im kol da la shechichu mikkol bishin dilhon. levatar darin dechamu demit yehoshua, vechol innun zekenim deitchazu lemebad nes al yedayyhu, amru, hasheta shaata kayyeyma lan. ma avdu atu legabbe amalek, amru it lechon leadkera, ma avdu lechon bene yisrael, umoshe rabbehon, vihoshua talmida dileh, deshetze lechon mealma, hasheta hu idana delet behu man deagin alayyhu, vaanan bahadayychu, dichtiv (Shoftim 6:3) midyan vaamalek uvene kedem vegomer, (Shoftim 6:2) mifne midyan asu lahem bene yisrael et hamminharot vegomer. la hava bealma, man deyaaved bisha becholla, kemidyan. vei tema amalek. begin kinat berit dekarivu legabbe berit. veal da kanne kudesha berich hu kina almin, dela yitneshe. amru vday hachi hu, velet hacha sefeka bealma.

Patach veamar, (Devarim 2:9) vayomer Adonai elay al tatzar et moav vegomer. vayomer Adonai elay, vechi ad hasheta la yedana deim moshe hava memallel kudesha berich hu, vela im achara, dichtiv vayomer Adonai elay. elay lamma. ella lemoshe pakid kudesha berich hu, dela leavasha lemoav. aval leachara la, ledavid la pakid da, uvegin kach elay al tatzar et moav, afillu litchum zeera dilhon. deha minnayyhu yippuk man deyitten nukemin leyisrael, veyinkom nukemayyhu, veihu david deata merut hammoaviya.

Veal titgar bam milchama, kol da itpekad lemoshe, ha leachara share. vei tema, liyhoshua uleinnun zekenim dahavo dearichu yomin batreh share. lav hachi. begin dechullehu mibbe dina demoshe havo, uma deitsar lemoshe, itsar lehu veod dela nafku adayin innun margelan tavan, deha beyomehon deshoftim nafka rut. uverateh deeglon malka demoav havat. mit eglon, dekatil leh ehud. umanu melech achara, veda berateh ishtearat, vahavat beve umana, uvisde moav. kevan deata tamman elimelech, nasbah livreh.

Vei tema degayyrah elimelech tamman. la. ella kol orche beta, umechla umishteyya olifat. ematay itgayyeyrat. levatar kad azlat benoomi, keden amrat, (Rut 1:16) ammech ammi vilohayich elohay. naama bivne ammon beyome dedavid nafka.

Keden sharat ruach kudesha al david. amar leh, david, kad kol alma madidna, veappilna advin, yisrael chevel nachalato havo, dachirna ma deavdu moav bechevel nachalato. ma ketiv, (Shmuel 2 8:2) vaymaddedem bachevel. behahu chevel nachalat Adonai. kol innun dahavo mehahu zara, hahu chevel achid behu.

Ketiv (Shmuel 2 8:2) melo hachevel. mahu melo hachevel. ella hahu dichtiv, (sefer acher beh) (Yeshayahu 6:3) melo chol haaretz kevodo. vahava amar, da hu leachayay, veda hu lekatla. vehahu chevel achid beinnun deitchazun lekatla. begin kach achid bechevel, ufashit chevel, al ma deavdu behahu chevel nachalat Adonai.

Umidyan, gidon shatze kol hahu zara, dela ashir minnayyhu, mikkol innun deavishu leyisrael beeta, o bemilla achara. ulechullehu deavishu leyisrael, kudesha berich hu natir lon devavu, venatal minnayyhu nukemin. aval i zeminin lemete minnayyhu tav lealma,
1411: Arich rugezeh veappeh immehon, ad deyappik hahu tav lealma, uvatar ken natil nukema vedina minnayyhu. amar ribbi elazar, hachi hu vadday, veda hu beriru demilla. amar hahu yannuka, mikkan ulehala, chavrayyay, atkinu mane kerava bidayychu, veagachu kerava.

Patach ribbi elazar veamar, (Tehillim 103:20) barachu Adonai (Bereshit 98) malachav gibbore choach vegomer. david malka zammin levarcha lekudesha berich hu, zammin lechele shemaya, deinnun kochavayya umazzale, ushear chayyaylin, veshataf lenishmeta dileh bahadayyhu, levarcha lekudesha berich hu. hada hu dichtiv, barachu Adonai kol maasav bechol mekomot memshalto barachi nafshi et Adonai. chatim benafsheh kol birchan.

Zammin lemalache meroma levarcha leh, dichtiv barachu Adonai malachav vegomer, vead la atu yisrael, malache meroma havo avde veshalleme asiyya. kevan deatu yisrael, vekayymu al tura desinay, veamru (Shemot 24:7) naase venishma, natle asiyyay mimmalache hashsharet, itkelilu bidvaro. umikkeden, asiyya havat beara deyisrael bilchodayyhu, umalachin kadishin bilchodayyhu. yisrael gamrin ushelemin asiyyay. veal da gibbore choach ose devaro bekadmita, ulevatar lishmoa. zakkain innun yisrael, denatlu asiyyay minnayyhu, veitkayyaym behu.

Amar hahu yannuka, netar garmach veatzlach bemanach. vechi shevacha da bilchodoy natlu yisrael, vela achra. amar shevacha da eshkachna, vela achra. amar hahu yenuka, kevan decharba dilach la atzlach. o ant la menanea leh kaddeka chaze, shevak charba leman deaggach kerava.

Shevacha illaa dela itmesar lemalache illae bilchodayyhu, ella bahade yisrael, man ihu. kadosh. beracha itmesar lon bilchodayyhu, kema deittemsar leyisrael. aval kadosh, la itmesar lon bilchodayyhu, ella bahade yisrael. dela mekaddeshe kedushsha, ella bahade yisrael. vei tema, veha ketiv (yeshaya 6) vekara ze el ze veamar, ematay bezimna deyisrael mekaddeshe letatta. vead deyisrael la mekaddeshe letatta, innun la amre kedushsha.

Begin dikdushsha mittelat almin salleka, vela mitteren, vehayeynu, vekara ze, ha chad. el ze, ha teren. veamar, ha telata. telat almin, innun lokkovlayyhu telat kedushshot. uvegin kach shevacha deyisrael denatlin kedusha letatta bilchodayyhu.

Amar ribbi elazar, hachi hu vadday, umillin illen okimna lon. vetu okimna, deha telat kedushshot itmesaru leyisrael letatta. min hay kera, vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim, ki kadosh ani Adonai. vehitkaddishtem chad. vihyitem kedoshim teren. ki kadosh ani Adonai, ha telata. hacha itmesar lon kedushsha. amar leh yaut. veha la idkerat merumecha, ad denatlat leh ana mibbatar kitfach, veshavvi lach bidach. mikkan ulehala tidkar lerumecha, deihu bidach. tuv leatar deshavkat.

Amar ribbi elazar, millin daanan behu, bivracha innun. barachu, may barachu. meshichu birchan, meatar dechol birchan nafkin, ad deyitavdun berecha. bisgiu meshichu deitmeshich, umiggo segiu demayin behahi berecha, miyyad yippeshun mayin nune sagiin, lechamma zinin. vehahu meshichu may hu. Adonai meshichu dinhora denahir, miggo hahu aspaklaryaa denahara, deitmeshach meella letatta.

Hay lemalache illae, deinnun beve meroma deidara illaa, ittemar barachu Adonai. anan deyatve letatta, amay barachu et Adonai. begin daanan tzerichin leamshacha alan, lehay et, uva neul legabbe malka, leachazaa anpoy. veal da amar david, (Tehillim 17:15) ani betzedek echeze panecha, ani betzedek vadday. uvegin kach, sheruta ditzlota, barachu et Adonai, leamshacha al reshan hay et. vechevan daanan mashchan lehay et alana, it lan lememar tzelota, uleshabbecha.

Uvegin kach asur levarcha lebar nash, ad la yitzle bar nash tzeloteh, veyamshich al resheh lehay et. vei yakdim vivarech lebar nash bekadmita, ha amshich lehahu bar nash bama al resheh, baatar dehay et.

Uvegin kach, lemalache illae ketiv barachu Adonai. vaanan et Adonai letosefet amar hahu yannuka, vadday ha yedana demane kerava dilach tavin innun, (sefer acher i tidkar) itdechar minnehon vela tinshe lon, vaday gevura devar nash deaggach kerava
1412: Berumecha vecharba ihu. aval mahu gibbore choach ose devaro lishmoa bekol devaro. amar ribbi elazar ha amarit. amar hahu yannuka, ha yedana dechela didroa dilach itchalash. hasheta ihu idana, dela leamtena, ella lealkaa bekirta, avna batar avna. kema deat amer (Shmuel 1 17:50) bakkela veeven. bivhilu da batar da. chadde ribbi elazar. vechaddu ribbi abba vechavrayya.

Patach hahu yannuka veamar, (Shir HaShirim 1:Adonai) shechora ani venava benot yerushalam vegomer. al tiruni sheani shecharchoret vegomer. millin illen ha ukemuha. aval beshaata deihi go rechimu saggi legabbe rechimaha, miggo dechiku rechimu, dela yachla lemisbal, azirat (203 amud bet) garmah biziru sagi, ad dela itchaziat (et) minnah, ella zeiru dinkuda chada, (umay ihi 10). keden itkasya mikkol chelin umashiryayn dilah. veihi amrat shechora ani, delet beat da chivvavra begavvivy, kishar atvavn. veda shechora ani, velet li atar leaala lechon techot gadpay. keohole kedar, tanenan, da 10, delet bah chivvavru lego. kiriot shelomo, da 6.

Uvegin kach al tiruni. la techomun bi kelal, daana nekuda zeera. me avdin guvrin takkifin, chayyaylin dilah. shaagin kearyayn takkifin, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 104:21) hakkefirim shoagim lattaref. umiggo kalin veshaagin takkifin, deka meshaagin kearyayn guverin takkifin dechela, shama rechima leella, veyada dirchimateh hi birchimu kevavteh, miggo rechimoy ad dela itchaziat middiukena ushefiru dilah kelal.

Ucheden, miggo kalin veshaagin deinnun gibbare chela dilah, nafik dodah rechima miggo hechaleh, bechamma matnan, bechamma nevizbezan, berechin uvusemin veate legabbah, veashkach lah shechora zeera, bela diyyukena ushefiru kelal, kariv legabbah, mechabbek lah, umenashshek lah, ad deatarat zeer zeer miggo rechin uvusemin. uvechedva dirchimaha deimmah, veitveniat, veitavidat betikkunaha, bediukenaha, bishpiru dilah, Adonai kemillekaddemin.

Veda gibbore choach, asu lah, veahdaru lah lediukenaha ushepiru dilah, detukepa ugevureta dilhon gerimu da. veal da ketiv, gibbore choach ose devaro. ose devaro vadday, dimtakkenin leh lehay davar, umehadderin leh lediyyukena kadmaa. (umikkan ulehala) kevan deittaknat veitavidat bediukenaha shappira kemillekaddemin, keden innun, vechol shear chelin, kayymin lishmoa, ma deihi amrat, veihi kayyeyma kemalka go cheleh, veda hu ose devaro vadday.

Kegavvna da letatta, bezimna dechayyayvin bedara, ihi itkasya veazirat garmah, ad dela itchaziat mikkol diyyukenaha, bar nekuda chada. vechad atan gibbore choach, vezakkae keshot, kivyachol, osim lehay davar. veanhirat zeer zeer, veitavidat bediukenaha bishpiru dilah Adonai kemillekaddemin.

Atu chavrayyay uneshaku, amar ribbi elazar, ilmale yechezkel nevia amar da, tavvavha havi bealma, natleh ribbi elazar, uneshakeh kemillekaddemin, amar hahu yannuka ana avarech. amru, at berich, velach yaut levarcha. amar kamma attun kadishin, kamma berachot zeminin lechu, meima kadisha, begin dela menatun li levarcha.

Patach veamar, (Mishlei 11:26) monea bar yikkevuhu leom uveracha lerosh mashbir. hay kera kemashmao. aval tanenan, kol bar nash chayyayv bevirchat hammazon. vei la yada, itteteh, o benoy, mevarchin leh vetavo meera lehahu gavra, dela yada levarcha, ad deyitzterich leitteteh velivnoy deyivarchun leh.

Vei hu yada, itzterich lechancha livreh, ulemehav leh kassa levarcha. uman demana leh, dela yitchannech, yikkevuhu leom. monea bar dela levarcha lekudesha berich hu, vela yitchannech bemitzvot. yikkevuhu leom, yikkevehu mibbae leh, o yikkevuhu leummim, deha leom chad hu, kema deat amer (Bereshit 25:23) uleom milom yeematz, may yikkevuhu leom. ella leem ketiv, leima kadisha. yikkevuhu lehay bar nash, demana lehahu bar millevarcha lekudesha berich hu.

Ana bera yechida havina leimmi, havu li kassa vaavarech lemalka kadisha, deyahav beveta deimmi, guverin dechela, demallilna kammayyhu millin takkifin, vezachena lon. uvegin kach ana avarech. vekodem da ityashev kera al tikkuneh, ha
1413: Monea bar yikkevuhu leom, man deamna bar kema deittemar, yikkevuhu leom. kema deat amer, (Vayikra 24:11) vayikov ben haishsha hayyisreelit et hashshem. uf hacha yikkevuhu, vayfarshun leh leem, yefarshu chetoy leimma kadisha. uveracha lerosh mashbir, lehahu bar nash dichanech bereh levarcha lekudesha berich hu, ulechannecha leh befikkude orayyta.

Veraza demilla, ketiv beraza dilella, (Mishlei 30) ma shemo uma shem beno ki teda. hahu shem yedia, Adonai tzevaot shemo. shem beno. yisrael shemo. dichtiv (Shemot 4) beni vechori yisrael. veha yisrael, kol maftechan dimhemnuta beh talyayn. veihu mishtebach veamar, (tehillim 2) Adonai amar elay beni atta. vehachi hu vday, deha abba veimma atteru leh, uvarichu leh bechamma birchan, veamru ufakidu lecholla, (tehillim 2) nashsheku var, nashsheku yeda lehay var. kivyachol, shaltanu yahav leh al kolla, decholla yiflechun leh. pen yeenaf, begin deattaru leh bedina verachame. man dezache ledina, ledina. man dezache lerachame, lerachame.

Kol birchan dilella, vetatta lehay bar sallekin umitatteran. uman demana birchan mehay bar, yefarshun chetoy kamme malka (sefer acher ema) kadisha, leem mammash. uveracha lerosh mashbir, man dimvarech (186 amud bet) veazmin bechassa divracha leman deitzterich leh, behay itbar sitra achara veitkafya bitbiru. veistellak setar kedushsha. veda hu dichtiv, uveracha lerosh mashbir. kema deihu mesallek umevarech lekudesha berich hu, veavid listar achara deyitbar, hachi kudesha berich hu mashich aleh birchan milella, vehahu deikre beracha, sharya al resheh.

Mikkan ulehala chavrayyay, havu venvarech. yahavu leh kassa divracha, uvarich. vechavrayyay kullehu havi bechedva, deha miyyoma dehillula deribbi elazar, la chadu chavrayyay, kehahu yoma deyatvu tamman. akdimu uvarichu leh bechedva biru delibba. amar hahu yannuka, let lechu leitparsha, ella miggo mille orayyta, vehachi tanenan.

Patach veamar (Shemot 13:21) vaAdonai holech lifnehem yomam beammud anan vegomer. vaAdonai, zakif taama leella, amay. ella, behahu shaata kamma yaut ushepiru havat lehay kalla, deitkefiat ad hasheta begaluta, vehasheta azlat bizkifu deresha beuchlusaha bechedva.

BevaAdonai zakif taama leella, holech lifnehem yomam. ad hacha la yada, i hay kalla azla lekammayyhu, i la, deha taama afsik bevaAdonai, ella ihi havat tamman, aval man deazil kammayyhu, sava illaa, mareh deveta, hahu deome (nusach acher deazmin) leh kudesha berich hu. umano. avraham. dichtiv, (Tehillim 42:9) yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo. uchetiv (Yirmeyahu 33:25) im lo veriti yomam valayla. yoma dechol yomin kelilan beh. yoma dishar yomin, ihu shear kol yomin vadday. veal da ikre yomam, vela yom. uvegin kach holech lifnehem yomam, hu azil bimama, vechalla azlat bellelya, dichtiv velayla beammud esh lehair lahem, da kalla, kol chad kidkachaze leh. veattun chavrayyay, yomam valayla yehe kammayychu, bechol shaata. neshakuhu, uverchuhu kemillekaddemin, veazlu.

Atu legabbe ribbi shimon, vesachu leh ovada. tavva, amar kama yaut hu. aval la salik bishma. aa dakik, kad salik nehoreh, salik lefum shaata, umiyyad kava veishteka. vetu ha amena nehora da mimma havi.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 112:2) gibbor baaretz yihye zaro dor yesharim yevorach. kad bar nash ihu gibbor baaretz, gibbor beorayyta, gibbor beyitzreh, gibbor baaretz vadday. salik nehoreh, veitmeshach beh meshichu sagi, keden dor yesharim yevorach, yevarech ketiv.

Amar ribbi abba, veha chamenan yannuke deamrin millin illain, vekayymin levatar reshin dealma. amar leh, yannuka deamar milla chada, o teren, lefum shaata, bela kavavna dilhon, muvetach bar nash beda, deyizke lemelaf orayyta beyisrael. aval da, dinhora dileh kayyeyma al kiyyumeh bedata shelim, lav hachi. vetu, deha kudesha berich hu vetiuvete dileh, learcha betappucha da,
1414: Zakkain attun tzadikayyay, dichtiv bechu, (Melachim 2 19:30) veyasfa peletat bet yehuda hannishara shoresh lemata veasa peri lemala. shoresh lematta, kegon avoy, deistallak mealma, veihu shoresh lematta, bimtivta dirkia. veasa peri lemala, bimtivta illaa. kama tava sharsha veibba. vei lav dela ehe mekatrega lekudesha berich hu, hoil vetiuveteh learcha beh, la hava man deyechul leshalletaa beh. aval yehe raava, deimmeh la techome tzaara aleh, vechen hava.

(Bamidbar 22:5) vayishlach malachim el bilam ben beor vegomer. hinne am yatza mimmitzrayim vegomer. hacha it esrin utemanya tevin, lokovel 28 dargin decharshe kusemin detzippor. veit leistakkela, man devaa lemallela beh bevilam, uleitchabbera bahadeh, amay shadar leh miyyad, ad la yete legabbeh, millin beferusha, dekaamar hinne am yatza mimmitzrayim veatta lecha ara li, hava leh leitchabbera bahadeh bekadmita, ulefayyeysa uleshochada leh, ulevatar leodaa leh milloy.
Ella amar ribbi yose, mehacha ishtemoda deha yada balak reuteh dehahu rasha, devaa leityakkera tadir bemillin ravrevin, velet leh tiuveta, ella kad avid bishin.

Balak kasam kesamin veavid charshin veatkin tzippara. veyada dedargin demoshe illain veyakkirin, vecharash becharshoy vekasam bekismoy, veyada dedargin devilam havo lokkovlayyhu, miyyad vyishlach malachim el bilam ben beor.

Petora: shema deatra hava. kema deat amer, (Devarim 23:5) mippetor aram naharayim lekallekka. amay ikre hachi. begin dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 65:11) haorchim laggad shulchan. ufatora hava mesadder tamman kol yoma. dehachi hu tikkuna desitrin bishin, mesadderin kammayyhu petora bemechla uvemishteyay, veavdin charshin, umekatrin lekamme petora, umitkanshin tamman kol ruchin misavin, veodin lon ma deinnun baan. vechol charshin vekosmin dealma al hahu petora havo, uvegin kach ikre shema deatra hahu petora. dehachi korin bearam naharayim lashulchan petora.

Patach veamar (Shemot 25:23) veasita shulchan atze shittim vegomer. uchetiv (Shemot 25:30) venatatta al hashshulchan lechem panim vegomer. kol innun mane kudesha, baa kudesha berich hu lemebad kammeh, leamshacha rucha kadisha meella letatta. hahu rasha devilam, hava mesadder hachi lesitra achara. vahava mesadder shulchan, venahama deikre lechem megoal, kema deittemar. dehachi azil setar achara batar kedusha, kekof batar bene nasha. ushelomo malka tzavavch veamar, (Kohelet 2:12) ki me haadam sheyyavo achare hammelech et asher kevar asuhu. veha (165) ittemar kera da.

Ta chaze, ketiv (Shoftim Adonai:4) Adonai betzetcha misseir betzadecha missede edom eretz raasha vegomer. beshaata devaa kudesha berich hu lemehav orayyta leyisrael, azal vezammin lehu livne esav, vela kibbeluha. kema deat amer (Devarim 33:2) Adonai missinay ba vezarach misseir lamo, vela bau lekabbelah. azal livne yishmael, vela bau lekabbelah, dichtiv hofia mehar paran. kevan dela bau, ahdar lon leyisrael, hachi tanenan.

Hasheta it leshaala, veha tanenan delet chattaa kad bar nash medakdek diyyukin deorayyta, vayishal sheeltoy leanhara milloy. hay kera la ityayshsheva, veit leshaala. kudesha berich hu kad azal leseir, leman nevia dilhon itgele. vechad azal lefaran, leman nevia dilhon itgele. i tema deitgele lechullehu, la ashkechan da lealmin. bar leyisrael bilchodayyhu, veal yede demoshe. veha ittemar dehachi mibbae kera lememar, Adonai lesinay ba, vezarach leseir lamo, hofia lehar paran, mahu misseir lamo, umahu mehar paran. kolla it leminda uleistakkela, veha shailna, vela shemana, vela yedana.

Kad ata ribbi shimon, ata veshail milla kemillekaddemin, amar leh ha sheelta da itammerat. Adonai missinay ba: kema deat amer (Shemot 19:9) hinne anochi ba elecha beav heanan, umissinay ba veitgele alayyhu. vezarach
1415: Misseir lamo, mimma deamru bene sair, dela baan lekabbela, mehay, anhar lon leyisrael, veosif alayyhu nehora vechavivu saggi. uf hachi, hofia veanhar leyisrael mehar paran, mimma deamru bene paran, dela bau lekabbela, mehay. osifu yisrael chavivu unehiru yatir kaddeka yaut.

Uma deshaalta al yeda deman itgele alayyhu. (401 chaze) (218 amud bet, 270, 219 amud alef) raza illaa ihu, veitgele milla al yedach. orayyta nafkat meraza illaa, deresha (sefer acher kaddisha) demalka setima, kad mata legabbe deroa semala, (sefer acher yemina) chama kudesha berich hu behahu deroa, dama bisha dahavu mitrabbe mittamman. amar, itzterich li levarra ulelabbena deroa da. vei la yamich hahu dama bisha, yafgim kolla. aval itzterich levarra mehacha kol pegimu.

Ma avad. kara lesamael, veata kammeh, veamar leh tive orayyta dili. amar, ma ketiv bah. amar leh, lo tirtzach. dalig kudesha berich hu laatar deitzterich. amar chas veshalom, orayyta da dilach hi, vedilach yehe, la baena orayyta da. ativ veitchannan kammeh, amar mareh dealma, i at yahavah li, kol shaltanu dili itavar, deha shaltanu dili al kettula ihu, ukeravin la yehon veshultanu dili al kochava demaadim, i hachi kolla itbetal mealma.

Mareh dealma, tol orayytach, vela yehe chulaka veachasana li bah. aval i nicha kammach, ha amma benoy deyaakov, lon itchaze. veihu chashiv deha dalttora amar alayyhu. veda hu vezarach misseir lamo, misseir mammash nafak nehora lon leyisrael. amar samael vadday, i benoy deyaakov yekabbelun da, yitavrun mealma, vela yishletun lealmin. ativ leh kama zimnin, veamar da, veamar leh ant buchera, velach itchaze. amar leh, ha leh bechiruta dili, veha ezdevan leh, vaana odeti. amar leh hoil vela bait lemehevi lach bah chulaka, itavar minnah becholla. amar yaut.

Amar leh, hoil vechach, hav li eta, ech abid dikabbelon lah benoy deyaakov deat amer. amar leh mareh dealma, itzterich leshachada lon, tol nehora minnehiru dechele shemayya, vehav alayyhu, uveda yekabbelun lah, veha dili yehe bekadmita. afshit minneh nehiru dechappeya aleh, veyahav leh, lemehav lon leyisrael, hada hu dichtiv vezarach misseir lamo. misseir mammash, da samael. dichtiv (Vayikra 16:22) venasa hasair alav. lamo leyisrael.

Kevan devier da, veabar dama bisha midderoa semala, ahdar lidroa yemina (sefer acher semala) chama beh uf hachi, amar hachi name itzterich lenakyay, middama bisha, deroa da. kara lerahav amar leh, tive at orayyta dili. amar leh, ma ketiv bah. dalig leh, veamar lo tinaf. amar vavy i yeruta da yachasin li kudesha berich hu, yeruta bisha, deyitavar bah kol shaltane, deha birchata demayya natilna, birchata denune yamma, dichtiv (Bereshit 1:22) peru urevu vegomer. uchetiv (Bereshit 17:20) vehifreti oto vehirbeti oto vegomer uchetiv (Bereshit 16:12) vehu yihye pere adam.

Share leitchannena kamme mareh, amar leh, mare dealma, teren benin nafakna meavraham, ha benoy deyitzchak, hav lon, velon itchaze. amar leh, la yachilna, deant buchera, velach itchaze, share leitchannena kammeh, veamar mareh dealma, becheruta dili yehe dileh, vehay nehora daana yaritna al da, tol vehav lon, vechach aved, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 33:2) hofia mehar paran.

May shena besamael ketiv vezarach, uverahav ketiv hofia. ella natal behahu nehiru deafshit minneh samael, cherev vekatola, lekatla bedina, ulekatla kedka yaut. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 33:29) vaasher cherev gaavatecha. af al gav dela hava dilach. venatal behahu birchata deafshit minneh rahav, zeer, keman deofa zeer mibbirchata dilhon, lemebad pirya ureviyya. begin kach hofia mehar paran, vela ketiv vezarach.

1416: Rivvot kodesh, dimmanan al shear ammin, veativu leh uf hachi. umikkullehu kavil venatil matnan, lemehav lon leyisrael. leasya, dehava leh chad mana malya missamma dechayye, venatir leh livreh. baa lemehav leh livreh, hahu pelayiton desama dechayye. asya hava chakkim, amar avdin bishin it beveti, i yindeun daana yahiv livri nevazbeza da, yavish beenayyhu, veyivun lekatla leh.

Ma avad. natal zeer misamma demota, veshavvi appitcha demana, kera leavdoy, amar lon, attun mehemnan kodamay, tivun lehahu sama. amru nechome may hu. natlu lemitam, ad la archu, bau lememat, amru belibbayyhu, i hay samma yahiv livreh, vadday yamut vaanan nirat leribbonana. amru kammeh, marana, samma da la itchaze ella livrach, veha agra defulechanana shevakna gabbach, zil vehav leh leshochada, diyykabbel samma da.

Kach kudesha berich hu, hu asya chakkim, yada dei yahiv orayyta leyisrael, ad la oda lon, bechol yoma havo radfin lon leyisrael alah, vekatlin lon. aval avad da, veinnun yahavu leh matnan unevizbezan, begin diykabbelun lah. vechullehu kabbil lon moshe, lemehav lehu leyisrael, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 68:19) alita lammarom shavita shevi vegomer. uvegin kach yartu yisrael orayyta, bela irura, uvela kitruga kelal. berich hu, berich shemeh, lealam ulealme almayya.

Ta chaze, edyam divne yisrael, illen matnan unevizbezan dekabbilu. uvegin kach, la hava shallit alayyhu mota, vela sitra achara, vela day lon day natlu orayyta bela irura kelal, ella dekabbilu nevizbezan umatnan mikkullehu. kevan dechatu ma ketiv, (Shemot 33:6) vayyitnatztzelu vene yisrael et edyam. innun (Tehillim 68:19) mattanot baadam. ma ishtear minnehon. hahu shevi, dichtiv alita lammarom shavita shevi vegomer.

Osifu vechatu, ma ketiv (Bamidbar 21:1) veyyishma hakkenaani melech arad. uchetiv, vayyillachem beyisrael vayishb mimmennu shevi (veim kol da) vechol zimna deyisrael tavin laavuhon devishmayya, innun nevizbezan (vecholla) yithaddar legabbayyhu, veitchappeyayn beh. ulezimna deate, kolla yithaddar dichtiv, (Devarim 30:3) veshav Adonai elohecha et shevutecha vegomer. mikkan ulehala ema millach.

Amar ribbi yose, (Shoftim Adonai:4) Adonai betzetcha misseir betzadecha missede edom eretz raasha. beshaata dekudesha berich hu tav misseir, dela kabbilu orayyta, eretz raasha vegomer. may tama raasha. begin devaat leahadra letohu vavohu, dehachi atne kudesha berich hu bealma, i yekabbelun bene yisrael orayyta, mutav. veim lav, ahdar alma letohu vavohu. kevan dechamat ara, deha azmin kudesha berich hu lechol ammaya diykabbelu orayyta, vela kabbilu. umikkol ammaya la ishtaaru ella yisrael bilchodayyhu, chashivat ara, deyisrael la yekabbelun kevavtayyhu, uvegin kach eretz raasha. kevan deamru naase venishma, miyyad shakata, hada hu dichtiv (Tehillim 76:9) eretz yara veshakata. yara bekadmita, ulevassof veshakata.

Veta chaze, begin deyisrael amru naase, la dachalin min kol asiyyay, deyechlun kol charashe dealma lemebad, vela mikkol kismin vecharshin dealma. may tama. chad, begin da. vechad, begin dechad appik lon kudesha berich hu mimmitzrayim, tavar kammayyhu kol zine charshe ukismin, dela yachlin leshalletaa alayyhu, vehahi shaata deata balak, hava yada da. miyyad vayishlach malachim el bilam ben beor petora asher al hannahar vegomer. may petora. ella deyatkin petora, veyive mittamman eta, ma yabid. asher al hannahar, al haneharim mibbae leh, may al hannahar. vadday hachi hu, deal chad nahara kayyeyma tadir.

Ribbi elazar veribbi abba, havo azle lemecheme leribbi yose beribbi shimon ben lakuneya, chamoy deribbi elazar, kamu befalgut lelya lemile beorayyta, yatvu. amar ribbi elazar, hasheta hu idana, dekudesha berich hu al beginta deeden, leishtasha betzadikayyay detamman. amar ribbi abba, shaashua da may hu, vehech yishtasha behu. amar ribbi elazar, milla da raza setima ihu,
1417: Temira legabbay, dela yedia. amar leh, vechi berekanayya havo samchin ravrevin demikkadmat dena behay alma, dela yadu, vela radfu abbatrah leminda al ma kayymin behay alma, uma havo mechakkan behahu alma.

Adonai, raza illaa, sheruta dinkuda illaa setima dela yedia. elohay, raza (Melachim 1 19:12) kol demama dakka, veihu sheruta dekayyeyma leshaala, veastim vela yedia, velet man deativ aleh, begin deihu satim vetamir veganiz.

Atta, da yemina, sheruta dekayyeyma leshaala, uleatava beh, vehu kohen illaa. kema deat amer (Tehillim 110:4-Adonai) atta chohen leolam al divrati malki tzedek. man al divrati malki tzedek. ella kohen illaa da, ihu dekayyeyma al davar, begin dehahu davar la kayyeyma, ella bimina. vehahu davar man ihu. malki tzedek, kach shemeh. umay deamar divrati, begin deitkeshar beh bedavid. vechol mille shevacha dileh, behahu davar atyayn. veal da divrati. uvegin kach, atta da kohen. veha okimna, ditlat duchete innun, deikre kol chad atta.

Aromimcha kulla kachada. ode shimcha kedka yaut, vehay shem yedia. ki asita pele, kissuya ulevusha, leitlabbesha nehora setima attika, reshita darga illaa, adam kadmaa, temira bechissuya dinhora achara.

Davar acher ki asita pele, ki asita alef. umahu alef. ha tanenan, alef bet, alef bina. aval diyyukena de, ihu telat sitrin. reshit deraza illaa deadam kadmaa. begin, divdiukena de, it teren deroin, chad mikkan, vechad mikkan, vegufa beemtzaita, vecholla raza chada. veihu raza deyichuda, 1. uvegin kach alef lechushevna echad, vehayeynu ki asita pele. verav hamenuna sava amar hachi, ki asita pele, pele da hu chad darga meinnun pelaot chachma. uman ihu. da (Iyov 28:7) nativ lo yedao ayit. veihu pele.

Etzot merachok kara lehay bekadmita pele, vehacha amar pele etzot merachok. ella hatam itzterich lemimne shit sitrin ledargin illain, (yeshaya 6) pele yoetz el gibbor avi ad sar shalom. vehacha, la ata lemimne chushebana. aval etzot merachok may ninhu. tere bade aravot. dechol eta dinvie mittamman atya. innun ikrun etzot merachok. emuna omen, teren deinnun chad, nahar vegan. da nafik meeden, veda ishteke minneh. ha hacha, kol raza setima dimhemnuta.

Amar ribbi elazar, bilam chayyayva man katil leh, vehech aktil. amar ribbi yitzchak, pinchas vesiateh katluhu. dichtiv, (Bamidbar 31:8) hargu al challehem. vetanenan, bekarta demiddeyan hava avid bechachmeta decharshoy, detasin baavira hu umalke midyan. veilmale tzitz dikdusha, utzelota definchas, daappillu lehon al ketilayyay, hada hu dichtiv al challehem. uchetiv (Yehoshua 13:22) veet bilam ben beor hakkosem hargu becharev. amar leh ribbi elazar, kol da yedana.

Amar rabbi shimon, elazar, kol milloy devilam chayyayva, takkifin innun, veha ukemuha chavrayyay, dichtiv (Devarim 34:10) velo kam navi od beyisrael kemoshe, veamru, beyisrael lo kam aval beumot haolam kam, umanu. bilam, veha okimna milla, moshe let dichvavteh, bechitrin illain. bilam let dichvavteh, bechitrin tattain. da besitra dikdushsha, veda besitra dismala. vei kol da hava bideh, vekol kach takkif bechachmeta, gevar diyshabbach garmeh bechela takkif, dichtiv veanochi ikkare ko, akar lecho mehay. heach yachilu lekatla leh.

Ella besifra dechachmeta dishlomo malka hachi amar, telat simanin innun. siman laavera, yerakon. siman lashtut, millin. siman dela yada kelum, shabbuche. veda achra lishar, shote bechol averot, kolla it beh.

Veha ketiv (Mishlei 27:2) yehallelcha zar velo ficha, veim la zar. ficha. lav hachi. ella i la havi man deishtemoda lach, aftach pumach lemallela beorayyta, uleodaa mille keshot beorayyta. ucheden petichu defumach beorayyta, yeshabbechun milach, veyindeun man annet, delet milla bealma deyishtemodun leh lebar nash, ella bezimna deaftach pumeh. pumeh hoda livne nasha man hu.

Hahu rasha devilam, shabbuche meshabbach garmeh becholla. veim kol da, genivu dedata ka ganiv, veistallak bemilloy. bemillin zeirin, hava avid ravrevin. ma deamar al innun dargin millin mesaavin hava amar, ukeshot amar. aval hahu rasha hava amar umeshabbach garmeh beorach satim, veistallak bemilloy, dechol man dehava shama, chashiv deistallak al kol nevie alma, dichtiv shomea imre el veyodea
1418: Daat elyon. man gever bealma, dehava shama mippumeh millin illen, dela chashiv delet bealma nevia mehemana kegineh.
Ukeshot hava, vehachi hava. neum shomea imre el, hachi hava. veyodea daat elyon hachi hava. vehahu rasha hava amar al dargin deitdevak behu, shomea imre el, mila deihu bisliku illaa.

Vehachi amar, shomea imre el, hael la ketiv, deha (Tehillim 18:31) hael tamim darko. aval setam el, el acher ihu. (Shemot 34:14) ki lo tishtachav leel acher shomea imre el, milla zeera ihi. vedami leman dela yada, deihu rav veillaa. shomea imre el, hahu deikre el acher, dichtiv ki lo tishtachav leel acher.

Veyodea daat elyon, al kol dargin dimsoovu, innun dimnahage arba deyamma useara. arbein chaser chad innun. vehahu rav hachovel, dechullehu mitnahage al yedoy, ihu elyon al kullehu. beda hava mitdavak hahu rasha, veamar dehava yada daat elyon, darga deihu elyon al kullehu menahage arba. man shama hachi dela itbehil bedateh, veyemma dela hava kegineh bealma. ella hahu rasha mashbach garmeh beorach satim veamar mille keshot, veganiv data divne alma.

Asher machaze shadday yechoze, man deshama da, chashiv dehava chame ma dela chame achara bealma. machaze shadday, da anfa chada, meinnun anfin dahavo nafkin mishshadday. velamma. divchachmeta da, achze telat, lokovel 300 deshadday, lokovel telat anfin deveh, veachze teren neviin, bade aravot, detamchin beh. lokovel 70 teren anfin deena bisha, lesatma lon. kad ata balak, amar ana echul lon. amalek bahade chachmeta da ata legabbayyhu, veyachil lon.

Veshadar levilam, veamar leh, ana tere atvavn daamalek it bi, deinnun 130, deinnun siyyuma daamalek. ana li 130, vaamalek 130, li siyyuma, uvach sheruta 32. amar leh rabbi shimon, hachi ema sheruta devalak 32, veshiruta devilam 32, sheruta devalak hava beh bevilam. vesiyyuma daamalek, hava beh bevalak, vesiyyuma devilam, hava sheruta daamalek.

Vei tema dela nechul lehon, begin decharshayya derabbehon moshe, dehava pashit yedeh, hay yeda it beillen ravrevin, deyachle becharshin leittakkefa yatir. vehayeynu dichtiv ukesamim beyadam, bidehem la ketiv, ella beyadam, yeda lokovel yeda, hachi shadar leh balak levilam.

Ulehachi machaze shadday kidamaran, ulehachi itanashu, veitanashu leella, veikrun machaze, kema deat amer (Melachim 1 7:Adonai) umul mecheza el mechoza. anfa denafak mittamman. uman hahu machaze aza veazael, deinnun nofel ugeluy enayim, veihu machaze shadday, dehava chama nofel ugeluy enayim.

An hava bilam behahi shaata. i tema bemidyan, ha ketiv veatta hinni holech leammi. i azal leh, man yahaveh bemidyan. ella hahu rasha, kevan dechama denaflu miyisrael 24 elef al etoy, itakkav tamman vahava bae minnayyhu agroy. uveod deitakkav tamman, ata pinchas veravrevane chela letaman.

Kevan dechama lefinchas, parach baavira, uteren benohi immeh, yonos veyomberos. vei tema, ha mitu beovada deegel, deha innun avdu. ella hachi hava vaday, veda hu dichtiv, (Shemot 32:28) vayyippol min haam bayom hahu kishloshet alfe ish. vechi la havo yade chushebana zeera da, vahare kama chushebanin acharanin, ramain illain veravrevanin, yada kera lemimne, vehacha kishloshet alfe ish. ella innun benoy devilam, yonos veyomberos, dahavo shakle kishloshet alfe ish.

Ella hahu rasha, kol charshin dealma hava yada, venatal uf hachi charshin divnoy, dahavo regilin behu, uvehu tas veistellak. pinchas chama leh, dehava bar nash chad tas baavira, vahava mistelak baavira meena, rama kala livne chela, amar it man deyada lemifrach abbatreh dehahu rasha, deha bilam ihu, chamu leh dehava tas.
Tzalya bereh deshivta dedan, kam venatal shaltanu deshallit al charshin, ufarach batreh. kevan dechama leh hahu rasha, avad archa ochara baavira, uvaka chamesh avirin behahu orach,

Rama leh kala pinchas veamar, tula detaninayyay deravin al kol chivyayn, hafoch bemizyaych. miyyad yada vegalle hahu achara, veal legabbeh. miyyad itgele, venachtu tarvayyhu kammeh definchas.

Ta chaze, hahu rasha ketiv beh vayyelech shefi, da hu elyon dedargin dileh, chivya dechura. tzalya natal teren, dechar venukeba. uvehahu shallit aleh, begin deshultanu deshallit alayyhu natal, veitkafyayn kammeh. veda hava (Bereshit 49:17) shefifon ale orach. al hahu orach, deavad hahu rasha, dichtiv (Bereshit 49:17) yehi dan nachash ale derech, da shimshon. shefifon ale orach, da tzalya.

Hannoshech ikkeve sus, da ira, dehava bahadeh dedavid, dehava ate middan, uvegineh, talya gevureteh bedavid, dichtiv (Shmuel 2 8:4) vayakker david et kol harechev. vayyippol rochvo achor, da seraya, dezammin lemete bahade meshicha deefrayim, veihu havi mishshivta dedan, vezammin ihu lemebad nukemin ukeravin bishar ammin. vechad da yekum, keden mechakke lefurekana deyisrael, dichtiv (Bereshit 49:18) lishuatcha kivviti Adonai. veaf al gav deokmuha lehay kera, aval beriru demilla kema deittemar, uchemma deokmuha. veal da ata kera veochach.

Kevan denachat hahu rasha lekamme pinchas, amar leh, rasha, kama gilgulin bishin avadt, al amma kadisha. amar leh letzalya, ta vekatleh, vela bishma, dela itchaze hay, leadkera aleh kedushsha illaa, begin dela tippuk nishmateh, vetitkelil bemillin dedargin kaddishin, vetitkayyem beh ma deamar tamot nafshi mot yesharim.

Behahu shaata aved beh kama zine mota, vela mit, ad denatal charba dehava takin (sefer acher chakik) aloy chivya mehay sitra, vechivya mehay sitra. amar leh pinchas, bedileh tol (nusach acher ketol leh), uvedileh yemut. keden katal leh, veyachil leh. dechach archoy dehahu sitra, man deazal abbatraa, bah yamut, uvah tippuk nishmateh, uvah titkelil. vehachi mit bilam, vedayyne leh bedinin behahu alma, vela itkevir lealmin. vegarmoy kullehu itrekavu, veitavidu kama chivyayn mezuhamin, menazzeke shear biryayn, vaafillu tolatin dahavo achle bisreh, ithadaru chivyayn.

Ashkachna besifra deashmoday, deyahav leh lishlomo malka, dechol man dehava bae lemebad charshin takkifin setimin deena. i yeda tinnara denafal tamman bilam, yishkach meinnun chivyayn dahavo migarmoy dehahu rasha, i yaktil chad minnayyhu, resha dileh beh yabed charshin illain, begufa dileh charshin acharanin, biznava dileh charshin acharanin. telat zine charshin, it bechol chad vechad.

Malkat sheva kad atat legabbe shelomo, meinnun millin deshailat lishlomo, amrat, garma dechivya ditlat charshin bema nitpas. miyyad (Melachim 1 10:3) lo haya davar nelam min hammelech asher lo higgid lah, ihi sheilat al da, vahavat itzterichat leinnun chivyayn. vela yachilat lenatla chad minnayyhu. ma ativ lah millin dahavo belibbah. kach oda lah, dichtiv vayyagged lah shelomo et kol devareha. innun chivyayn, la yachlin lon kol bene alma, bar mimmilla deraza chada, umay ihu. shichvat zera rotachat.

Vei tema man yachil. ella, beshaata dehahu shichvat zera appik bar nash, kad ihu betiuveta, appik lah lishma dehahu chivya, biruta detiuveta. kad nafik birtichu, natle leh miyyad bilvusha chada, vehahu levusha zarkin legabbe chivya, miyyad kafif resheh, vetafsan leh, kema detafis tarnegola deveta. vei bechol mane keravin dealma, yiggechun bechad minnayyhu, la yachlin leh. uvehay, la itzterich bar nash bealma mane kerava, vela milla achara vela itzterich leistammera minnayyhu deha kullehu itkafyayn legabbeh. keden itdavaku innun millin bilvavah, vetaivat lehay.
