1420: Reshaim yirkav. zakkain innun zakkae keshot, alayyhu ketiv, (Tehillim 140:14) ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha vegomer.

(Bamidbar 22:6) veatta lecha na ara li et haam hazze vegomer. ribbi abba patach, (Tehillim 102:1) tefilla leani ki yaatof vegomer, telat innun dichtiv behu tefilla. veokmuha milla da, (aval milla da) chad hava moshe, vechad hava david, vechad ani, deitkelil behu, veitchabbar behu. vei tema, ha ketiv (Chavakuk 3:1) tefilla lachavakkuk hanavi, ha arba innun. ella chavakkuk lav begin tefilla hava, veaf al gav dichtiv beh tefilla, tushebachta vehodaa ihu lekudesha berich hu, al deachaya leh, vaavad immeh nissayon ugevuran, deha bereh deshunammit hava.

Aval 3 innun deikrun tefilla. (Tehillim 90:1) tefilla lemoshe ish haelohim, tefilla da delet kegineh bevar nash achara. (Tehillim 86:1) tefilla ledavid, tefilla da ihi tefilla, delet kegineh bemalka achara. tefilla leani, tefilla ihi meinnun 3. man chashiva mikkullehu. havi ema tefilla deani. tefilla da, kadim lattefilla demoshe. vekadim lattefilla dedavid, vekadim lechol shear tzelotin dealma.

May tama. begin deani ihu tevir libba. uchetiv, (Tehillim 34:19) karov Adonai lenishbere lev vegomer. umiskena avid tadir ketata bekudesha berich hu. vekudesha berich hu atzit veshama milloy. kevan detzalle tzeloteh, patach kol kavvi rekiin, vechol shear tzelotin deka sallekin leella, dache lon hahu miskena tevir libba, dichtiv tefilla leani chi yaatof. chi yitattef mibbae leh, may chi yaatof. ella ihu avid ittufa lechol tzelotin dealma, vela alin ad ditzlota dileh alat.

Vekudesha berich hu amar, yitattefun kol tzelotin, utzelota da teul legabbay. la baena hacha be dina diydunun benana, kammay lihevu tarumin dileh, vaana vehu bilchodana. vekudesha berich hu ityaychad bilchodoy, beinnun tureamin, behahu tzelota, dichtiv velifne Adonai yishpoch sicho. lifne Adonai vadday.

Kol chele shemaya shaalin illen leillen, kudesha berich hu bemay itasak, bemay ishtedal. amrin, ityachada betiuveta bemanin dileh, kullehu la yadu ma itavid mehahu tzelota demiskena, umikkol innun tureamin dileh. delet tiuveta lemiskena, ella kad shafich dimoy betureamu, kamme malka kaddisha. velet tiuveta lekudesha berich hu, ella kad mekabbel lon, veushedu kammeh veda ihi tzelota, deavid ittufa lechol tzelotin dealma.

Moshe tzalle tzeloteh, veitakkav kama yomin behay tefilla. david chama, dechol kavvin, vechol tare shemaya, kullehu zeminin leaftecha lemiskena, velet bechol tzelotin dealma, dekudesha berich hu atzit miyyad, kitzlota demiskena, kevan dechame hay, aved garmeh anya umiskena, pashat levusha demalchuta, veyativ beara kemiskena, amar tefilla. dichtiv, tefilla ledavid hatte Adonai aznecha aneni. vei tema amay. begin ki ani veevyon ani. amar leh kudesha berich hu, david, velav malka ant, veshallita al malchin takkifin, veat avid garmach ani veevyon. miyyad ahdar tzeloteh begavvna achara, veshavak milla deevyon veani, veamar shamra nafshi ki chasid ani. veim kol da kolla hava beh bedavid.

Amar leh ribbi elazar, shappir kaamart. veim kol da (sefer acher veal da) itzterich leh levar nash detzalle tzeloteh, (lemeheve tamman ani veevyon) lemebad garmeh ani, begin detiul tzeloteh bichlala dechol aniyyim. deha kol neture tarin, la shavkin hachi lemeal, kema deshavkin lemiskenin, deha bela reshuta alin. vei avid bar nash garmeh, veshavvi reuteh tadir kemiskena, tzeloteh salleka, veirat beinnun tzelotin demiskenin, veitchabbarat behu, vesalkat bahadayyhu, uvichlala dilhon alat, veitkabbelat biruta kamme malka kaddisha. (behu)

David malka, shavvi garmeh bearbaa archin, shavvi garmeh bahade miskene. shavvi garmeh bahade chasidim. shavvi garmeh bahade avadim. shavvi garmeh bahade innun demasre garmayyhu venafshayyhu al kedushshat shemeh. shavvi garmeh bahade miskena. dichtiv ki ani veevyon ani. shavvi garmeh bahade chasidim, dichtiv shamra nafshi ki chasid ani. begin deitzterich leh levar nash, dela leshavvaa garmeh rasha. vei tema i hachi la yefaret chetoy lealmin. lav hachi. ella kad yefaret chetoy, keden ihu chasid, deate lekabbela teshuva, appik garmeh missitra bisha, dehava betinnufa dilah ad hasheta, vehashsheta itdevak bimina illaa, deihi peshuta lekabbela leh.
Vela tema, dela mekabbel leh kudesha berich hu, ad diyyefaret chetoy miyyoma dehava bealma. (sefer acher i hachi) an (o) innun
1421: Deitkesun minneh, dela yachil leadbeka. ella la itzterich lefarsha, bar innun deyidkar minnayyhu. vei shavvi reuteh behu, kol acharanin itmashshechan abbatrayyhu. deha tanenan, en bodkin chore beta illain leella, vela innun tattain letatta beviur chametz. ella kevan devadik kefum chezu deenoy ma deyachil leadbeka, kolla itmeshach batar da, veitbettil bahadeh.

Vehachi garsenan bingaim, 24 rashe evarim innun dela metamin mishshum michya. vechahana la hava atrach abbatrayyhu, vehayeynu dichtiv, (Vayikra 13:12) lechol mare ene hakkohen. atar deyachil kahana lemecheze machtesha beistakkeluta chada, vela itzterich lemaacha garmeh, ulearama enoy hacha vehacha. uf hachi. la itzterich lefarta chetoy (lemive) min yoma dehava, deinnun chore beta tattain, vela innun deitkesu, dela yachil leadbeka, deinnun chore beta illain leella. (sefer acher ella) ta chaze lechol mare ene hakkohen, vechullehu itmashshechan abbatrayyhu. veal da shavvi david garmeh go chasidim.

Shavvi garmeh bahade avadim, dichtiv, (Tehillim 123:2) hinne cheene avadim el yad adonehem. uchetiv, (Tehillim 86:2) hosha avdecha atta elohay. shavvi garmeh bahade innun demasre nafshayyhu al kedushshat shemeh. dichtiv, (Tehillim 86:4) sammeach nefesh avdecha ki elecha Adonai nafshi essa. bechol hane arba, aved garmeh david malka kamme mareh.

Amar ribbi elazar, aremit yeday bitzllo lekamme malka kaddisha. deha tanenan, asur leh levar nash learma yedoy leella, bar betzallu, uvevirkan vetachanunim lemareh. dichtiv, (Bereshit 14:22) harimoti yadi el Adonai el elyon, umetargeminan, aremit yeday bitzllo, deha etzbean deyadin millin illain it behu. vehasheta ana hachi avidna. vaamena dechol man deillen arba yesadder kamme mareh, veavid garmeh biruta, betikkuna da kaddeka yaut, betikkuna da la tehadar tzeloteh berekanayya.

Bekadmita eved, lesaddera shevacha kamme mareh, ulezammera kammeh. veda betushebchan dekamme tzelota. ulevatar eved, levatar detzalle tzelota daamida, ihu avda desidder tzelota demareh. ulevatar eved, levatar detzalle kol tzeloteh, veazil leh, veal da david telat zimnin avad garmeh bitzlota da eved. dichtiv hosha avdecha atta elohay. sammeach nefesh avdecha. uchetiv (Tehillim 86:16) tena uzzecha leavdecha. ha telat zimnin, itzterich leshavvaa garmeh eved.

Levatar leshavvaa garmeh go innun demasre nafshayyhu al kedushat shemeh, vehayeynu beyichuda dishma yisrael, dechol man deshavvi hachi reuteh behay kera, itchashiv leh keillu masar nafsheh al kedushshat shemeh.

Levatar leshavvaa garmeh ani, bezimna deal vedafik dashin derome meromim, kad amar emet veyatztziv, (usemich) geula litfilla. lemehevi bitzlota daamida, tavir libba, anya umiskena. uleshavvaa reuteh, leitkallela go miskene, bitviru delibba, bimichu denafsha.

Levatar leshavvaa garmeh go chasidim, beshomea tefilla, lefarsha chetoy. dehachi itzterich yachid beshomea tefilla, begin leitdabbeka bimina, difshuta lekabbela leinnun detavin, ucheden ikre chasid, ha arba illen kedka yeot.

Man kalil lechol hane, hahu deka itzterich lechalla lon, vehay ihu eved, deachlil lechol shear. telat avdin innun bitlat duchetin, vechullehu chad. vealayyhu ketiv, hinne cheene avadim el yad adonehem vegomer. ben eved leeved innun acharanin. ben eved kadmaa, leeved tinyayna, it leh lemimsar nafsheh al yichuda dikdushat shemeh, uleshavvaa garmeh ani umiskena bitzlota daamida, uleshavvaa garmeh go chasidim beshomea tefilla. eved telitaa batar desiyyem vesider kolla.

Tenan, behahi shaata desidder bar nash kol hane siddurin arba, biru delibba, kudesha berich hu nicha kammeh, ufaris yemineh aleh, behahu eved telitaa, vekara aleh veamar leh, avdi atta, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 49:3) vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar. vadday tzelota
1422: Dehay bar nash, la tehdar berekanayya lealmin. ata ribbi abba uneshakeh.

Amar ribbi elazar, ta chaze, tere eved meinnun telata, innun dechalle kol hane, deha telitaa kayyeyma lechatma beh chotama leella, leshavvaa beh yeda mimina demalka, uleishtabbecha beh. aval hane teren, kadmaa vetinyayna, innun kelala decholla. vedavid shabbach garmeh behu, dichtiv, (Tehillim 116:16) anna Adonai ki ani avdecha ani avdecha vegomer, deillen kelale dechol shear. telitaa bach kayyeyma lemifrak li, dichtiv hosha avdecha atta elohay. man dimsadder da, yedia lihavi leh dekudesha berich hu mishtebach beh, vekara aleh avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar. ata ribbi abba uneshakeh.

Amar ribbi abba, al da karenan, (Tehillim 19:11) hannechemadim mizzahav umippaz rav vegomer, kama metikin millin attikin desidderu kadmae, vaanan kad taamin lon, la yachlin lemechal. vadday hachi hu, veha kera ochach al telata avdin, veinnun chad, uvaatar chad. uteren kidkaamart, vechad deihu leitattera beh kudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Vayikra 25:55) ki li vene yisrael avadim avaday hem vegomer. (Bereshit 131 amud bet) lo yimmachru mimkeret aved. begin dekudesha berich hu itzterich leitattera behay telitaa. veal da lo yimmachru lishma deaved, deha dekudesha berich hu havi.

Patach ribbi elazar veamar, (Yeshayahu 50:10) mi vachem yere Adonai vegomer. may shomea bekol avdo. hay kera ukemuha chavrayyay 8 bitzlota, vehachi hu. man deragil lemete leve kenishta letzallaa, veyoma chada la ate, kudesha berich hu shail aleh veamar, mi vachem yere Adonai shomea bekol avdo asher halach chashechim veen noga lo. may shomea bekol avdo. beman. i tema binvia, o gevar achara, man yahav nevia, o gevar achara litzlota. divgin detzalle tzeloteh shomea bekol nevia, o digvar bealma.

Ella hahu detzalle tzelotin bechol yoma, ihu shomea behahu kol, dekare leh kudesha berich hu, umishtebach beh, veamar deihu avdo vadday. shomea bekol, bemay kol. behahu deikre avdo. shevacha illaa ihu denafik aleh kol deihu avdo. vetu, dekala ishtema bechol innun rekiin, deihu avda demalka kaddisha, veda hu shomea bekol avdo.

Asher halach chashechim veen noga lo, vechi begin dela ata letzaluye halach chashechim. ella okmuha. aval ad la yitkanneshun yisrael levatte kenesiyyot letzallaa, sitra achara kayyeyma vesagir kol nehorin illain, dela yitpashshetun veyippekun al almin. utelat zimnin beyoma azle setar achara, dechar venukeba, umeshattin bealma, vehahu iddan atkan litzlota, begin dela havi tamman kitruga kelal.

Ucheden ihu iddan litzlota, begin (ki tissa 191 amud alef) deinnun azle limshatteta, beture chashuch, vehar nishpe, keden petichin kavvi nehorin illain, venafke vesharian al batte kenesiyyot, bereshehon deinnun detzallan tzelotin, umitpallegan nehorin al reshayyhu. vekudesha berich hu shail, al hahu dela ishtechach tamman, veamar chaval al pelanya, dehava ragil hacha, vehasheta dehalach chashechim veitavar mikkamme nehorin, vehalach leshatteta beturayya bealma, venafak mehahu noga nehora denahir, velet (leh) beh chulaka, en noga lo, kema deitpelig vesharya al acharanin detamman, kama tavin itavidu minneh. (en noga lo hasheta dehalach chashechim) veillu hava tamman, yivtach beshem Adonai, bichlala deeved kadmaa. veyishshaen belohav beraza deeved tinyayna.

Amar rabbi shimon, elazar beri, vadday ruach nevua sharya alach. amar ribbi abba, arya bar arya, man yekum kammayyhu, kad shaage lemitraf tarpa. kol aryayn dealma takkifin, veillen yattir mekullehu. kol aryayn dealma, kashyayn leappaka tarpa mippumayyhu, veillen nochin leappaka mippumayyhu tarpa. innun tarpe tarpa, veyahave lecholla.

Asher halach chashechim, asher halchu mibbae leh. amar ribbi elazar, (Shemot 188, 148 amud bet, 95 amud alef) begin deinnun sharyayn bechibbura, umiyyad mitparshan. halach chibbura, chashechim itparshan. sharan bechibbura, veitparshan miyyad. kegavvna da, (Yechezkel 1:4) ruach seara baa, kelal dechar venukeba. baa
1423: Vehi shavkat leh, miyyad mitparshshan. (leel 187 amud alef) (ad kan matzati ulefi dati chaser behetek)

(Bamidbar 22:2) vayyar balak vegomer. ribbi elazar amar, vadday ma (186) deamar ribbi chiyyay, milla setima hava. aval ketiv, (Tehillim 84:4) gam tzippor matza vayit uderor ken lah vegomer. vechi david malka, al tzippara bealma, hava amar milla da.

Ella, kema detanenan, kama chavivin nishmatin kamme kudesha berich hu. i tema kol nishmatin dealma. lav hachi. ella innun nishmatehon detzaddikayyay, detamman madorehon bahadeh, madorehon leella, umadorehon letatta. vehachi ittemar. gam tzippor matza vayit, illen ruchehon detzaddikayyay.

Tanenan, telat shurin innun legan eden, uven kol chad vechad, kama ruchin venishmatin metayyeylin tamman, veithanan merecha deinnugin detzaddikayyay dilgo, af al gav dela zachu lemeal. aval innuga deruchehon detzaddikayyay dilgo, (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin lo raata elohim vegomer.

Veyomin reshimin it beshatta, veinnun yome nisan, veyome tishre, deinnun ruchin meshattan ufakdan laatar deitzterich. veaf al gav dezimnin saggiin meshattan, aval yomin illen reshimin innun, veitchazun al gabbe shurin deginta, kol chad vechad kechezu detzipparin metzaftzefan, bechol tzafra vetzafra.

Vehahu tziftzufa shevacha dekudesha berich hu, utzelota al chayye bene nasha dehay alma. begin deillen yomin, yisrael kullehu mitassekin bemitzvot, uvefikkudin demare alma. ucheden bechedu itchazan tzipparin metzaftzefan, veal gabbe shurin degan eden metzaftzefan meshabbechan veodan umetzallan al chayye dehay alma.

Amar rabbi shimon, elazar vday shappir kaamart, devadday innun ruchin tamman. aval ma tema uderor ken lah. amar, hachi olifna, da hi nishmeta kaddisha, desalleka leella, vesalleka laatar tamir veganiz, deayin lo raata elohim zulatcha vegomer.

Amar ribbi shimon, elazar vadday shappir kaamart, veshappir ihu. aval kol da began eden diltatta hi, uchema deamrat hu, vehachi hu vday, gam tzippor matza vayit, illen ruchin kaddishin, dezachu lemeal ulemeppak levatar, begin dimshattan (162 amud alef) veitchazun kechezu ditzipporin, veillen ruchin matza vayit. vadday kol chada vachada it lon madorin yedian lego.

Veim kol da, kullehu nichvin mechuppa dechavrayyhu. innun deit lon deror, vecheru mikkolla. vekudesha berich hu achze lon hechala temiru chada ganiz, deayin lo raata elohim zulatcha, vehahu hechala ikre kan tzippor. umittamman mitatterin itrin lemashiach bezimna deate, uveyomin reshimin, telat zimnin beshatta, kudesha berich hu bae leishtashea beinnun tzaddikayyay, veachze lon hahu hechala temira ganiz, dela yadin vela ishtemodan beh, kol tzaddikayyay detamman.

Asher shata efrocheha et mizbechotecha, illen innun tzaddikayyay, deishtachlalu bivnin kaddishin, dezachu lattora shebbichtav, velattora shebbeal pe behay alma. veillen ikrun teren madbechan. mitatteran lekamme malka kaddisha, deha zechuta divnayyhu behay alma, aggin alayyhu, umeatterin lehu tamman. man rucha zakkaa lechol hay. hay deshata efrocheha, leolfa lemizbechotecha vegomer. mikkan ulehala ema millach, deha bela kissufa itchazena tamman.

Patach kemillekaddemin ribbi elazar veamar, gam tzippor matza vayit, da yitro. uderor ken lah, da benoy, dahavo belishkat haggazit, olfe orayyta, vechatchin millin deorayyta befumayyhu. matza vayit mahu. ella bekadmita natlu vesharu bemadbera, natlu meinnuga demidyan, umimmetiku detamman, vesharu bemadbera. kevan dechama kudesha berich hu, deal orayyta hava kissufa dilhon, mashich lon mittamman, veail lon lelishkat haggazit. uderor ken lah, kolla chad. tzippor deror kolla ihu chad. (Shoftim 4:17) chever hakkeni. (Shmuel 1 15:6) vayyomer shaul el hakkeni vegomer.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, vayyar balak ben tzippor. vechi may shena deadkir shema daavoy mishshear malchin. ella yitro itmeshach veitavar meavoda zara, veata leitdabbeka beyisrael, hu uvenoy, vechol alma nidduhu
1424: Balak mibbene benoy hava, veitavar mearcha deavoy, kevan dechamu save moav vesave midyan, dahavo bahade hadade beachva dilhon beavoda zara, bechulaka dilhon, deyitro uvenoy itdavaku bishchinta, veda itmeshach minnehon. atu veamlechuhu alayyhu behay shaata, dichtiv uvalak ben tzippor melech lemoav baet hahi. baet hahi hava melech, ma dela hava mikkadmat dena. veal da ketiv ben tzippor, ma dela itchaze lemebad hachi. vayyar balak, vayyishma mibbae leh, mahu vayyar. reiyyay chama, veyada dezammin hu leminpal bida deyisrael, veyisrael leminpal bidoy bekadmita, ulevatar ihu bida deyisrael, vayyar balak ben tzippor.

Ribbi abba patach, (Shir HaShirim 1:8) im lo tedi lach hayyafa bannashim tzei lach beikve hatztzon. kenishta deyisrael amrat legabbe malka illaa. kenishta deyisrael, mahu kenishta. da ihu atzeret, kenishu. kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 10:25) meassef lechol hammachanot. man dechanish lechol mashiryayn illain legabbeh.

Umiggo dilzimnin nukeba ikre kenishta, veittemar atzeret, kema deat amer (Bereshit 20:18) ki atzor atzar Adonai, denakit vela yahiv. hachi hu vday, deha miggo mehemnu saggi dilah, dela ashkechan bah muma, (sefer acher mocha) yahavu lah bela ikkuva kelal. veihi kad mata legabbah, kol man dichnishat, atzar umeatzer umeakkevet, dela nachit venahir, ella kefum talla, tippin tippin, zeer zeer. may tama. begin dela ishtechach letatta mehemnuta, ella kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 28:10) zeer sham zeer sham, zeer zechuta, uzeer anharuta detala, midda lokovel midda.

Deilmale tishachach mehemnuta, kema deishtechachu bah, arikat bechol sitra vesitra, bela ikkuva kelal, veihi chaddat. ucheden yahavin lah mattenan unevizbezan saggiin da al da, vela yehon meakkevin lah kelal. aval tattain innun meakkevin lon, umeakkevin lah, ucheden ihi atzeret. atzor atzar Adonai vadday, kivyachol, yahiv tamtzit, vela yattir.

Veim kol da keimma yahavat livnin bitmiru, dela yadin bah, hachi avidat lon livnaha yisrael. veolifna miggo butzina kaddisha, divshaata deihi selikat leminkat innugin vechissufin, umuma ishtechach behu beyisrael letatta, keden mate legabbah tippa dechardal umiyyad adiat, veyativat alah yomin beminyan. ucheden yadin leella, demuma behu beyisrael.

Veittear semala miyyad, umashich chuta letatta. (Bereshit 27:1) vattichhena enav merot, ma dehava mistakkal beayin shepiru, bichlala deavraham, bela dina kelal, keden vattichhena enav merot, merot vday, milistakkela bichlala derachamanu. keden attearu desamael bekal takkif, leatteara al alma. kema deat amer vayyikra et esav beno haggadol vegomer. gadol ihu legabbe mashiryayn desitra achara, ihu gadol, venahig lechol arbin deyamma, dearuran berucha bisha, leatbea lon beumeka deyamma, beinnun metzulot yam dileh.

Vechad kudesha berich hu hu berachamanu, keden kol chatain vechol chovin deyisrael, yahiv leh, veihu attil lon limtzulot yam. kol mashiryayn dileh metzulot yam ikrun, veinnun natle lon, umeshatte behon lechol shear ammin. vechi chatain deyisrael, vechovin dilhon, zarkin umitpalgin leamma dilhon. ella, innun mechakkan umetzappan lemattenan dilella, kechalbe lekamme patora. vechad kudesha berich hu natil kol chovayyhu deyisrael, vezarik alayyhu, kullehu chashve demattenan unevizbezan deihu baa lemehav leyisrael, deabar minnayyhu, veyahiv lon. umiyyad kullehu kachada zarkin (sefer acher vechezu vezarkin) lon al shear amin.

Ta chaze, kenishta deyisrael, ihi amrat bekadmita, (sefer acher begaluta) (Shir HaShirim 1:Adonai) shechora ani venava, azirat garmah lekamme malka illaa. ucheden sheilat minneh veamrat, (Shir HaShirim 1:7) haggida li sheahava nafshi echa tire echa tarbitz batzohorayim. teren zimnin echa echa amay. ella ihi remiza al teren charbenin, ditren mikdashin. dekaran kolla echa echa. echa tire, becharban bayit rishon. echa tarbitz, becharban bayit sheni. veal da teren zimnin echa echa.

Tire tarbitz, lav da keda. galuta devavel, deihi zeman zeer, kare beh tire. veal galuta deedom, deihu zeman saggi, kare beh tarbitz. veal da teren zimnin echa echa. vetu tire tarbitz, yire mibbae leh, yarbitz mibbae leh uf hachi, deha al yisrael amrat. ella ihi amrat al nafshah echa tire kallatcha livnaha begaluta, dihon ben shear ammin. echa tarbitz batzohorayim, hech tattif ihi alayyhu tallin umayin, go chamimu detzohorayim.
Shallama ehye keotya, beshaata deyisrael karan miggo aku, dechiku dilhon, ushear ammin
1425: Mecharfin umegadfin lon, ematay tifkun min galuta. elahachon hech la avid lechon nissin. (veinnun mashekachen garmayyhu veamri ko tare lon beyomin kadmain. ko tarbitz bemayin kaddishin latzenanea chamimu dareshapeyn vashelahevabeyn dilhon. veinnun meshabbacha kol da) (nusach acher veinnun meshabbechan lekudesha berich hu vaavaden leh im kol tzaara vearko degaluta veamri ko tare lan beyomin kadmain ko tarbitz immana begaluta uferok lana lezimna batraa kol da shevacha vameyhemanevatea teivin lon leyisrael.) vaana yativ keotya, vela yachilat lemebad lon nissin, ulemehav lon nukemin. ihu ativ legabbah, im lo tedi lach hayyafa bannashim. hay kera hachi mibbae leh, im lo tedi hayyafa bannashim. lach amay. ella im lo tedi lach: leattekfa garmach begaluta, uleittakfa chela, leaggana al benach. tzei lach, tzei lach leittakfa beikve hatztzon. innun tinokot deve rabban, deolfe tora.

Urei et gediyyotayich, illen attike mishshadayim, deka mistalleke mealma veitmashshechan leve metivta illaa, deihi al mishkenot haroim, al dayyka, bemishkanot haroim la ketiv, ella al mishkenot haroim, da metivta dimtatron, detamman kol takkifin vinokin dealma, umanhige orayyta behay alma beisur vehetter, bechol ma deitzterichu bene alma, deha ikve hatztzon innun tinokot kidamaran.

Amar ribbi elazar, ikve hatztzon, innun talmide deve rav, deka atyayn levatar bealma, veashkechan orayyta beorach meshar, veorcha peticha, veal da innun mechaddeshan millin attikin bechol yoma, ushechinta sharyay alayyhu, vetzayyta lemillehon, kema deat amer (Malachi 3:16) vayyakshev Adonai vayyishma. amar ribbi abba, hachi hu vadday, vecholla chad milla.

Davar acher im lo tedi lach. lach lamma. ella bechol atar deyisrael begaluta, ihi immehon begaluta. veal da ketiv lach, uchetiv (yeshaya 63) bechol tzaratam lo tzar. veda hu lach. hayyafa bannashim, hayyafa, ihi amrat deihi ukkamta, kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim 1) shechora ani. veihu amar legabbah, yafa at, shappirta, hayyafa bannashim, shappirta ihi al kol dargin, uchetiv (Shir HaShirim 1) yafa at rayati.

Davar acher hayyafa bannashim, tavta betivu. daavidat tivu livnaha, bitmiru bignizu. vekudesha berich hu saggi tav aleh, kol ma daavidat livnaha bitmiru bignizu, af al gav dela mechashran ovadin. mikkan deitchaze leabba kad imma rachama al benin vetaiv aleh kol ma deavdat livnaha rachamin bitmiru af al gav dela mechashran ovadoy.

Amar ribbi abba, tavvavhna al hahu dichtiv, (Devarim 21:18) ki yihye leish ben sorer umore vegomer, vetafsu vo aviv veimmo vegomer, vetanenan, divhahi shaata amar kudesha berich hu lemoshe ketov. amar leh moshe, mareh dealma, shavik da, it abba deavid keden livreh. umoshe merachik hava chame bechachmeta, kol ma dezammin kudesha berich hu livne yisrael. amar, mareh dealma, shevok milla da. amar leh kudesha berich hu lemoshe, chamena ma deat amer, ketov vekabbel agra. at yadat vaana yeda yattir. ma deat chame, alay hahu ovada. derosh kera vetishkach.

Behahiv shaata ramaz leh leyofiel, rabbana deorayyta, amar lemoshe, ana darishna lehay kera. ketiv ki yihye leish, da kudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Shemot 15:3) Adonai ish milchama. ben, da yisrael. sorer umore, dichtiv, (Hoshea 4:16) ki kefara sorera sarar yisrael. enennu shomea bekol aviv uvekol immo, da kudesha berich hu ucheneset yisrael. veyisseru oto, dichtiv, (Melachim 2 17:13) vayyaad Adonai beyisrael uvihuda beyad kol nevie chol choze vegomer. velo shama alehem, dichtiv velo yishmeu el Adonai vegomer. vetafsu vo aviv veimmo, bedata chada. behasekama chada.

Vehotziu oto el zikne iro veel shaar mekomo. el zikne iro, el zikne iram, veel shaar mekomam, mibbae leh, may el zikne iro, veel shaar mekomo. ella, el zikne iro, da kudesha berich hu, veel shaar mekomo, da keneset yisrael. zikne iro, illen yomin kadmain, yomin attikin (sefer acher subbin) decholla. shaar mekomo, da musaf shabbat.

Veim kol da, af al gav decholla yadin, dina leella ihu, begin deve dina deimma kerivin innun leyisrael, veachadin behu, vechol kariv la dain dina likrivim (lekariveh), ufasul ihu ledina. bekadmita ma ketiv, el zikne iro veel shaar mekomo, kevan dechama kudesha berich hu deinnun kerivin, miyyad salik dina mishshaar mekomo, ma ketiv batreh, veamru el zikne iro
1426: Lechod. veel shaar mekomo la ketiv, ella el zikne iro.

Benenu ze vday, velav dishar ammin. sorer umore enennu shomea bekolenu. may shena, deha bekadmita la ketiv zolel vesove, ulevatar ketiv zolel vesove. ella man garim lehu leyisrael, lemehevi sorer umore legabbe avuhon devishmayya, begin deihu zolel vesove, bishar ammin dichtiv, (Tehillim 106:35) vayyitarvu vaggoyim vayyilmedu mimaasehem uchetiv vayyochal haam veyishtachavu, deikara visoda achila ushetiyya, kad avdin bishar ammin. da garim lon, lemehevi ben sorer umore, legabbe avuhon devishmayya.

Veal da uregamuhu kol anshe iro vaavanim. illen kol shear ammin, dahavo mekallein lehu baavanim, vesatrin shurin, umenattetzin migdalin, vela mehane lon kelum. kevan deshama moshe keden, katav parsheta da.

Veim kol da hayyafa bannashim, tava veyakkira bannashim dealma. tzei lach beikve hatztzon, ha okimna, illen batte kenesiyyot uvate midrashot. urei et gediyyotayich, illen yannuke deve rav, dela taamu taam chova bealma. al mishkenot haroim, illen melammede tinokot vereshe yeshivot.

Davar acher al mishkenot haroim, chaser 6. innun bishin, illen malche haemori, denatlu yisrael ara dilhon, leraya miknehon, uleve mare yahav yisrael ara da. keden shama balak, deara dahavat chashiva kol kach, avdu yisrael kerava da, vesatru lah, ad deshavu lah be mare. keden ishtedal bechol ma deishtedal, veshattaf bahadeh levilam.

Vayyar balak, ribbi chizkiyya patach, (Yeshayahu 56:1) ko amar Adonai shimru mishpat vaasu tzedaka ki kerova yeshuati vegomer. kama chavivin yisrael kamme kudesha berich hu, deaf al gav deinnun chavu kammeh, vechavin kammeh bechol zimna vezimna, ihu avid lon leyisrael, zedonot kishgagot.

Vehachi amar rav hamenuna sava, telat dinin bave dina, takkinu (sefer acher rabbanan) besidre matnita. chada, kadmita, bearba avot nezikin hashshor vechulei. tinyayna, talit deishtechach. telitaa, shuttafin veraza daaveda. may tama. ella, kudesha berich hu bechol zimna, avid lon leyisrael zedonot kishgagot. veinnun desidderu matnitin ditlata bave, hachi sidderu, orach dikra naktu, dichtiv, (Shemot 22) al kol devar pesha, vehay pesha ihu delav bezadon, uman ihu. al shor, al chamor, al se, da bava kama, dehacha hu beinnun millin. al salma, da bava metzia, al kol aveda, da bava telitaa.
Deorach kera naktu. dechad mata levava metzia, hava amar, sheruta deka naktu betalit da, amay. kevan deishtechach kera, amar, vday da halacha lemoshe missinay, uviaru kol mille derabbanan.

Ko amar Adonai, may shena bechol ducheta dinvie, dichtiv ko amar Adonai, uvemoshe la ketiv hachi. ella, moshe dahavat neviuteh miggo aspaklarya denahara dilella, la ketiv beh ko. aval shear neviim, dahavo menabbein miggo aspaklarya dela nahara, naviu miggo ko. (nusach acher leachazaa decholla ihu chad belo piruda deaf al gav deamru vechulei, lo amro ella miggo 25)

(Bamidbar 22:6) veatta lecha na ara li et haam hazze vegomer. veatta, ribbi elazar amar, amar hahu rasha, vadday shaata kayyeyma li lemebad ma daana bae. chama, vela chama yaut. chama kama alfin naflin miyisrael al yedoy lizman zeer, amar vadday hasheta shata kayyeyme li. uvegin kach veatta, vela bezimna achara.

Lecha, lech mibbae leh, may lecha. amar, nizdarez garman lehahu derachif begadpoy alayyhu, lehahu dishmeh ko. veatta lecha, niggach kerava behahu ko. (veatta lecha kema deat amar 0 veatta lishlol moav)

Amar, ad hasheta la hava bealma man deyechul lehu, begin hahu patrona dekayyeyma alayyhu, hasheta deshata kayyeyma lan, lecho nabed kerava. vechol eta dehahu rasha lecho hava, dichtiv veanochi ikkare ko akar lehahu ko meatreh. vetarvavyyhu beeta bisha lehay ko havo, kema deat amer (Tehillim 2:2) al Adonai veal meshicho, la yadu deha levatar, hay ko akar lon mealma.
Ki atzum hu mimmenni. vechi ad hahu shaata an agachu beh kerava venatzchu leh. bean atar arau becharba dilhon, vahavu gavrin
1427: Kegibbarin leachazaa gevureta dilhon. may ki atzum hu mimmenni. ella hahu rasha chakkim hava, vechame lemerachik, chama ledavid malka, deate merut hammoaviya, gibbar takkif kearye, veavid keravin takkifin, venatzach lemoav, veshavvi lon techot ragloy. amar atzum hu. hahu deyarta hahu gevureta, chad malka dilhon, minan yippuk leshetzaa lemoav.

Ulay uchal nakke bo. hay kera hachi hava leh lememar, ulay uchal akke bo. o ulay nuchal nakke bo. ella hahu rasha hava chakkim, amar, chamena yeda chada, dechad arya takkifa, paris (172) ragla (yeda), i ichul immach, denitchabbar (sefer acher tarvavna) tarvavyyhu (venitchabber) venigra mehahu arye yeda da, ad la yete hahu malka lealma, vela yitterach yat moav meatreh.

Ara li, may ara li. amar ribbi abba, hahu rasha bitre lishane kaamar levilam. chad amar ara li, vechad amar kava li. ma ben hay lehay. ella amar leh, ara li asvin vecharshin dereshe dechivyayn, veshavvi lon bakkedera decharshayya, kevan dechama decheleh yattir befuma, tav veamar, ulecha na kava li.

Vaafillu hachi, hahu rasha devalak, la shavak charashoy, ella lakit kol zine isvin, charshe dereshe dechivyayn, venatil kedera decharshin, venaitz lah techot ara elef vachamesh mea ammin, veganiz lah lesof yomin. kevan deata david, kara bithoma, elef vachamesh mea ammin (al elef vachamishsha mea ammin), veappik mayya min tehoma, venasich al madbecha. behahu shaatta, amar, ana asche hahi kedera, (Tehillim 60:10) moav sir rachtzi. sir rachtzi vadday.

Al edom ashlich naali, may ashlich naali. ella da uf hachi lemerachik hava, dichtiv, (Bereshit 25:30) vayyomer esav el yaakov haleiteni na min haadom haadom hazze ki ayef anochi. haleiteni: haleata mammash, petichu defuma ugerona lemivla. amar david lehahu balan, melaet haleattin, ana armi aleh naali, lemistam geroneh.

Ale feleshet etroa, uf hachi da lemerachik istache david, amar, kenaan sitra bisha desitra achara ihu, ufelishtim mittamman innun, lesitra achara ma itzterich. terua. dichtiv, (Bamidbar 10:9) vechi tavou milchama beartzechem vahareotem vegomer, letavra cheleh vetukepeh, uvegin kach ale peleshet etroa, vehachi itchaze lon.

Veatta lecha na ara li et haam hazze ki atzum hu mimmenni. ribbi chizkiyya patach, (Yeshayahu 11:5) vehaya tzedek ezor matnav vehaemuna ezor chalatzav. hay kera kolla ihu chad. may chiddusha ata leashmoinan, deha tzedek hayeynu emuna, veemuna hayeynu tzedek. ezor matnav, hayeynu ezor chalatzav, la ashkechan kera kehay gavvna.

Ella lav tzedek keemuna, veaf al gav decholla chad, vechad darga ihu. aval bezimna dekayyeyma bedina kashya, umekabbela missetar semala, keden ikre tzedek, dina mammash. vehayeynu (Yeshayahu 26:9) ki kaasher mishpatecha laaretz tzedek lamdu yoshve tevel. dehay darga demishpat, rachame ihu. vechad itkeriv mishpat betzedek, keden itbesam (kolla), veyachlin bene alma, lemisbal dina detzedek.

(Veal da tzedek lav ihu kaamavenah) emuna, beshaata deitchabbar bah (keden ihu) emet, lechedva. vechol anpin nehirin, keden ikre emuna. vit vavtranuta lecholla, vechol nishmatin sallekin, mitchayyeyve bechamma chiyyuvin dechayyayvin bishin, vechevan divpikkadon sallekin (akdim), ahdar lon berachame, vechas alayyhu. ucheden ikre emuna, velet emuna bela emet.

Hasheta ezor matnav, veezor chalatzav. mahu teren ezorin hacha. umatnayim vachalatzayin af al gav dechad innun, teren dargin innun, chad leella, vechad letatta. leella besheruta, ikre matnayim. letatta besofa, ikre chalatzayin, kema deat amer (yeshaya lev) vachagora al chalatzayim, besofa, al resh yerechayim. kad itteta betzaara, menattekan innun chalatzayim, meresh yerechayin, veshaviat yedaha bichiva alayyhu.
Uvegin kach liggevura ulekarva, tzedek ezor matnav. vehachi itzterich. lerachamanu uletav, emuna ezor chalatzav, bechad darga yedin alma, veshalta litren sitrin, chad rachame
1428: Vei tema, tzedek dina takkif ihu, veha ketiv (Vayikra 19:15) betzedek tishpot amitecha. (Devarim 16:20) tzedek tzedek tirdof. vechamma inun. vadday hachi hu. deha tzedek let beh vavtranuta kelal. uf hachi man dedain lechavreh, la itzterich lemebad leh vavtranuta min dina kelal, ella betzedek, dela yishgach lirchimu. mozne tzedek, bela vavtranu lehay sitra ulehay sitra, leman deyahiv uleman dimkabbel. uvegin kach chad darga ihu, veitpaleg litren sitrin. vehani teren sitrin, 2 ezorin, kayyman, chad lishar ammin, vechad leyisrael. uveshaata denafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, itazzeru beezorin illen, chad dikrava. vechad hava dishlama. (chaser kan) (vecholla hava betzedek)

Kad ityaat balak, amar vaagarashennu min haaretz. amar hahu darga deka (sefer acher itachadat beh haaretz veda vechulei) itachadan beh, min haaretz vadday. veda hu ki atzum hu mimmenni vday, man yechul leaggacha ulekayyeyma behu beyisrael darga dilhon takkif hu middili. uvegin kach, vaagarashennu min haaretz. vei mehay eretz agarashennu, veattarech yateh mineh, ichul lemebad kol reuti, chela dilhon bemay ihu. befuma, uveovada. ha puma dilach, veovada dili.

Ki yadati et asher tevarech mevorach vegomer. vechi mean hava yada. ha ukemuha, deha bekadmita ketiv, (Bamidbar 21:26) vehu nilcham bammelech moav harishon vayyikkach et kol artzo miyyado, deagar leh levilam vechulei. aval ki yadati, yedia vadday yada, bechachmeta dileh. et asher tevarech mevorach, may itzterich hacha beracha, deha begin kelala hava azil. vei hahu milla dehava yada min bilam bekadmita, kelala hava, may et asher tevarech mevorach.

Ella milla hacha, vela yedana bah, vela zachena bah, ad deata ribbi elazar vedarash, (Tehillim 34:2) avarcha et Adonai bechol et tamid tehillato befi. uchetiv (Tehillim 16:7) avarech et Adonai asher yeatzani. man (sefer acher itzterich) deitzterich birchata min tattai. et, deha itachad behu keshalhova biftila. vedavid dehava yada da, amar avarcha et. amar hahu rasha, hahu darga dilhon, achid behu, begin birchan dilhon, deka mevarchin leh bechol yoma. chela it lach levarcha lehahu darga, uteakker lah minnayyhu veda hu ki yadati et asher tevarech mevorach vegomer. uveda nechul behu. tevarech lehahu darga vetilut liftila. veal da amar, veanochi ikkare ko, akar lah minnayyhu, dela yitachad behu.

Vetu ikkare ko, angid veamshich lehahu darga, bechovin umisavi uvekeri uvetumea deavdu benoy, vehi taavid immehon gemira. miyyad vayyelchu zikne moav vezikne midyan ukesamim beyadam, dela yemma hahu rasha delav himneh innun zinin charshin deitzterich beyado lehitakkev alayyhu (veyitakkev alayyhu). (45 shechaser kan timtza besof hassefer 70 11 1)

Patach veamar, (Yirmeyahu 30:11) veatta al tira avdi yaakov veal techat yisrael ki ittecha ani vegomer. hay kera ittemar veattearu beh, aval ad kean it leatteara yattir. atta, may ihu. raza aron habberit. deda ihu darga deazla begaluta bahade benaha amma kaddisha. moshe beshaata devaa rachamin alayyhu deyisrael, ma ketiv (Bamidbar 11:15) veim kacha at ose li hargeni na harog, veokmuha.

Aval hachi amar moshe, darga chad diyyehavit li ikre atta, begin delet leh perishu mimmach. Adonai dilah itachad behu beyisrael. i at (sefer acher teshetze lon mealma) ishtetze lon bealma, ha Adonai dishma da deitachad behu itavar minneh, i hachi at ose li, de ikkara dishma da itteakar.

Veal da amar yehoshua levatar, (Yehoshua 7:9) uma taase leshimcha haggadol, deha vadday shema da ikkara visoda decholla, atta hu Adonai. umoshe af al gav dekudesha berich hu la amar leh, hachi yada, deha beha talyay, vechova garim. veatta al tira avdi yaakov vegomer, kolla chad. ki ittecha ani, ha okimna ki itti atta la ketiv, ella ki ittecha ani. ki eese chala bechol haggoyim vegomer, bechol haggoyim eese chala.

Rav hamenuna kadmaa amar, dechiku veaku deyisrael, kamma tav vechamma toalta garim lon. rifyon dishar ammin, kama bishin garim lon. dechiku veaku deyisrael, garim lon detav lihevi vetoalta. umay nihu.
1429: Kalla. kolla dachik. rifyon dishar ammin, garim lon rifyon uvish, vehay ihu chala. vehachi itchaze lon, deha kol rifyon bela dechiku dehava lon behay alma, garim lon rifyon levatar bela dechiku, chala. (Yeshayahu 28:22) ki chala venecheratza shamati. ki eese chala. chala berifyon. leyisrael dehava lon dechiku veaku, kalla, (Yeshayahu 61:10) vechakkalla tade cheleha.

Man cheleha. illen yisrael, deinnun kelim dehay kalla, yisrael dehava lon dechiku veaku, (Amos 9:11) akim et sukkat david hannofelet, sukkat shalom. lishar ammin dehava lon rifyon tzara vetzuka, (tzuka) chala berifyon, kema dehava lon bekadmita. veal da ki eese chala bechol haggoyim vegomer, veotcha lo eese chala, deha la itchaze lach. deha dachik havit bekadmita zimnin saggiin, bidchiku, degaluta tadir, vedachik tihye kalla. (sefer acher tareyt keleha)

Veyissarticha lammishpat, hay kera hachi mibbae leh veyissarticha vammishpat, deha ematay yissure beshaata dedina. (vehacha lav hachi ella) may veyissarticha lammishpat. ella ketiv (Yeshayahu 3:14) Adonai bemishpat yavo im zikne ammo. vehahu yoma, akdim kudesha berich hu asvavta leyisrael, ad la yealun ledina, begin deyechlun lekayyeyma beh. umay asvavta, hi divchol shaata veshaata kudesha berich hu yahiv yissurin leyisrael zeer, zeer bechol zimna vezimna, uvechol dara vedara begin dechad yealun vlyoma dedina rabba, deyechun metayyay, la yishlot alayyhu dina.

Venakke lo anakkekka, mahu. ella, kad yisrael bilchodayyhu, vela alin bedina im shear ammin ovde kochavim umazzalot, kudesha berich hu avid lon lego mishshurat haddin, vehu mechapper alayyhu. uvezimna dealin bedina bishar ammin, me avid. yada kudesha berich hu deha samael appotroppesa deesav, yete leadkera chovehon deyisrael, vechanish kullehu legabbeh leyoma dedina, veha kudesha berich hu akdim lehu asvavta, veal kol chova vechova lake venakke lehu beyissurin zeer zeer. veda hu venakke, beyissurin. uvegin kach bedina dikshot, la anakkekka mealma bedina batar desavalt yisurin zeer zeer.

Vetu la anakkekka, af al gav deattun banay, la eshbok chovechon, ella itpera minchon zeer zeer, begin dittehevun zakkain leyoma dedina rabba. kach atan ledina, ata samael, bechamma pitkin alayyhu. vekudesha berich hu appik pitkin deyisurin, desavlu yisrael al kol chova vechova, venimmochu kol chovin, vela avid lon vavtranuta kelal. keden tashash kocheh vecheleh desamael, vela yachil lon. veyitavar mealma, hu, vechol sitroy, vechol ammin. hada hu dichtiv, veatta al tira avdi yaakov vegomer, begin kach veyissarticha lammishpat venakke lo anakkekka.

Vedavid malka amar, (Tehillim 11:2) ki hinne harshaim yidrechun keshet konnu vegomer. veaf al gav dehay kera ha okmuha, al shevna veyoach memanan dechizkiya ittemar, aval hay kera al samael vesiateh uf hachi ittemar, dechol ovadoy veetoy al yisrael ninhu. balak uvilam hahu orach mammash naktu, veha ittemar dachavura bisha avdu. amru, amalek: am lak, amma delaka lon, kechivya demache biznava dileh, ha anan yattir. balak: ba lak. ata man delake lon kiruteh. bilam: bal am, let amma, velet raya. shema dilan garim leshetzaa lon uleakera lehu mealma.
Vekudesha berich hu chashiv begavvna achara shemehon, bevalak bal, bevilam bal, ha bilbel. ma atvavn ishtaaru emek, bilbel imka demachashava dilhon, dela yishletun bealma, vela yishtaarun bealma.

Amar rabbi shimon, elazar, yaut amrat, aval balak, tippach rucheh begehinnam. uvilam yishtachakun tamman garmoy verucheh. vehachi hu eta bisha natlu al patrona. al hay ko, dechashivu leakera lehay ko, vechashivu lesitra bisha lesalleka leh befuma uveovada.

Amar hahu rasha, kadmae ishtedalu vela yachilu. dor hafelaga ishtedalu, vela yachilu. avdu ovada, ufuma chaser minnayyhu, delishanhon itbalbal, vela yachil. aval ant, ha pumach shannan, velishanach metutkkan bitren sitrin illen, et asher tevarech mevorach, vasher taor yuar, hahu sitra deat bae lesalleka leella befumach velishanach, istelik. vehahu sitra deat bae lemelat, bechela defumach telot (vesitra kammach) vecholla bach talyay
1430: Deha ovada ittakkan. aval bemilla talyay kolla, veal da (sefer acher beovada) keovada denachash ana atkin. veant tashlim kolla befumach, hahu sitra dittevarech mevorach, vehahu sitra detaor yuar.

Vehu la yada dekudesha berich hu (Iyov 12:20) mesir safa leneemanim vetaam zekenim yikkach, vecholla birshuteh kayyeyma. mesir safa leneemanim, ellu dor hafelaga, devilbel lishanehon, dela yishletun bemilla kelal. dichtiv, (Bereshit 11:7) asher lo yishmeu ish sefat reehu. vetaam zekenim yikkach, ellu bilam uvalak detarvavyyhu havo beeta chada, dichtiv vayyaal balak uvilam par veayil bammizbeach.

Ta chaze, hahu rasha devilam, kol ovadoy levish, berum libba. tarvavyyhu havo sallekin karbena, dichtiv vayyaal balak uvilam. vechol madbechin balak hava mesadder, veihu rasha, hava mashbach garmeh veamar, et sheva hammizbechot arachti vaaal par veayil bammizbeach. veillu levalak la shattaf bahadeh. amar kudesha berich hu, rasha, kolla yedana, ella shuv el balak, veat la tzarich lemallela ella vecho tedabber. hada hu dichtiv, vetaam zekenim yikkach.

Davar acher vetaam zekenim yikkach, dichtiv vayyelchu zikne moav vezikne midyan ukesamim beyadam. taama deinnun zekenim natal minnayyhu, vela yachilu lemishlat becharshayyhu kelal. vaydabberu elav divre balak. millin beitgalya, vela bilchishu. pagim udena hava, ufagim ena, ufagim ragla. mittelat duchetin hava pagim. metukan hava lesitra achara, vehachi itzterich lehahu sitra achara, atar desharya pagim, zina lezineh.

(Bamidbar 22:8) vayyomer alehem linu fo hallayla vahashivoti, innun ketiv, vaydabberu elav. veihu ketiv, vayyomer alehem. linu fo hallayla, begin delelya ihu shaata desitra achara havi, lecharshayya, beshaata demishtakkeche veshalte sitre bishin umitpashshetan bealma. kaasher yedabber Adonai elay. shabbuche ka meshabbach garmeh bishma daAdonai.

Vayyeshvu sare moav, vesare midyan itperashu minnayyhu, vela bau lemetav tamman. vesave moav ishtaaru, dichtiv vayyeshvu sare moav, bilchodayyhu. yaut avde midyan, deitperashu mikkol vechol minnayyhu. veilmale la havo machan besofa dahavo beeta devilam, leshalcha neshehon leyisrael bashshittim lemite lon. ukera ochach chova dilhon, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 25:18) ki tzorarim hem lachem benichlehem asher nikkelu lachem al devar peor veal devar kazbi bat nesi midyan achotam vegomer. bitren illen chavu. vahava chova dilhon saggi. machu biznava levatar. uvegin kach illen ishtaaru bahadeh, veillen azlu bilchodayyhu.

Davar acher vayyeshvu sare moav im bilam, kama yaut hava lon livne midyan deazle, i reuta dilhon hachi. aval yeshiva deyativu innun demoav, garma lon tav, begin deishtaaru tamman. uman deazlu innun demiddeyan, garme lon bish. may tama. illen chashshu likara demilla dekudesha berich hu, veyativu. veillen la chashshu lah kelum. veazlu learchayyhu.

Beshaata deamar hahu rasha, vahashivoti etchem davar kaasher yedabber Adonai. miyyad izdaazau innun demoav lemilla da, veyativu tamman. veinnun demiddeyan la chashshu leda kelum, veazlu lon, veitanashu levatar. veal da vayyeshvu sare moav im bilam. behahu lelya, hahu rasha lachish lechishin, veavid belatin, veamshich aleh rucha milella, miyad veyavo elohim el bilam, elohim setam, darga dileh missitra achara dismala.

(Bamidbar 22:9) vayyomer mi haanashim haelle immach. darga dileh, missitra achara dismala hava, deka itzterich lemishal. veaf al gav dechavrayyay attearu beda, begavvna achara, veinnun amre dekudesha berich hu (eved beh) nisyona avad leh bemilloy. telata havo, chad chizkiyya. vechad yechezkel. vechad bilam. teren la kayymu kedka yeot, vechad kaim. umanu. yechezkel. dichtiv, (Yechezkel 37:3) hatichyena haatzamot haelle, veihu tav veamar, vayyomer Adonai elohim atta yadata. chizkiyyahu amar, (Melachim 2 20:14) meeretz rechoka bau elay mibbavel. bilam amar balak ben tzippor melech moav shalach elay, chashiv ana beene malchin veshallitin. vekudesha berich hu shail leh lemite leh, dichtiv, (Iyov 12:23) masgi laggoyim vayyeabbedem veokmuha.
Chad kuti shail leribbi elazar, amar leh, chela takkifa chamena beh bevilam, yattir mimmoshe. deillu bemoshe ketiv vayyikra el moshe. uvevilam
1431: Ketiv, vayyikkar elohim el bilam, uchetiv vayyavo elohim el bilam.

Amar leh, lemalka deyativ behechaleh al kurseyay, chad segir kara letara. amar, man hu devatash letara. amru, segir pelan. amar la yeul hacha, vela yetannef hechala, yedana dei bishlicha ema leh, la chayish. veyezil beri veyisteav veyikrav bahadeh. aval ana ezil, veagzim beh, deyirchak archeh mimotava divri, vela yisav leh. akdim malka, veata legabbeh, veagzim. veamar leh, segir segir, mena raglach mearcha divri share tamman, vei lav, omena, dechatichin yaavdun gufach bene shifchotay.

Rechima demalka kare ledasha. amar malka, man hu. amru, rechimach pelanya. amar, rechima chaviva denafshay, la yikre leh kala achara, ella ana. tzavavch malka veamar, pelanya pelanya ul, chaviva denafshay, rechima dili, atkinu hechalin lemallela immeh.

Kach bilam ihu segir, rechika mibbene nasha, kara letara demalka, shema malka, amar segir misava la yeul, vela yetannef hechala dili. ana itzterich lemezal leagzema leh, dela yikrav legabbe tara divri, vela yisav leh, veal da vayyavo elohim el bilam vegomer. amar leh, segir segir lo telech immahem, lo taor et haam ki varuch hu. la tikrav legabbe divri, hen letav hen levish, mesaav ant becholla. aval bemoshe ketiv, vayyikra el moshe, kala demalka, vela al yede shelicha achara. meohel moed mehechala kaddisha, mehechala metukkena, mehechala yakkira deillain vetattain teivin legabbeh, vela yachlin lemikrav legabbeh.

Vayyomer bilam el haelohim balak ben tzippor. vehu amar melech moav, malka chashiva shalach elay. melech moav. chamu gauta dehahu rasha, (deafillu leh levalak lo chashiv kelum) dichtiv melech moav, vela amar lemoav, michlal gavra dela itchaze lemalka, veha itavid malka lemoav. kadmaa ma ketiv beh. (Bamidbar 21:26) vehu nilcham bammelech moav harishon, malka bar malka. chashiva bar chashiva. aval da melech lemoav ketiv. kera ashid melech lemoav. veha ittearna, deitkavvavn hu legauta libba rav. kol malchin dealma, shalchin legabbay sheluchehon. (sefer acher vayyomer bilam el haelohim balak ben tzippor melech moav shalach elay. chamu gauta dehahu rasha, deamar melech moav, velo amar lemoav, bemalka demoav. kadmaa ma ketiv beh. 2 vehu nilcham bammelech moav harishon, malka bar malka. chashiva bar chashiva. aval da melech lemoav ketiv. ukera ashid aleh melech lemoav beet hahi gavra dela itchaze lemalka veha itavid malka. veha ittearna, dametakevaven lageavetaa delibba rav. dechol malchin dealma, shalach laggabbay shillucheha.) (vacheshaybanea legabbe)

Ribbi pinchas hava azil lemecheme beratteh, intu deribbi shimon, dahavat bemara. vahavu azle immeh chavrayyay, vehu hava rachiv bechamreh. ad dehava azil bearcha, paga bitren arvae, amar lon, bachakal da ittear kala miyyomin dealma. amru leh, miyyomin dealma let anan yadin. miyyomin dilan, anan yadin. deha yoma chad, havo innun listin mekappeche archin deguverin behahu chakla, ufagu beinnun yudae, veatu lekappecha lon. veishtema merachik behay chakal, kal dachamara da, denahak tere zimne, veata shalhova deeshsha behahu kala (nusach acher behahu chakla) veokid lon. veishtezivu innun yudae. amar leh. arvae, arvae, bemilla da deka amartun li, tishtezvun yoma da millistin acharanin, deka mechakkan lechu bearcha.

Bacha ribbi pinchas, amar, mareh dealma rachasha denisa da avdat begine, veishtezvun innun yudae, vela yedana. patach veamar, (Tehillim 136:4) leose niflaot gedolot levaddo ki leolam chasdo. kama tivu avid kudesha berich hu im bene nasha, vechamma nissin archish lon bechol yoma, vela yada ella ihu bilchodoy. bar nash kam betzafra, vechivya ate lekatla leh, ubbar nash shavvi ragleh al resheh, vekatil leh, vela yada beh bar kudesha berich hu bilchodoy, havi, leose niflaot gedolot levaddo. bar nash azil bearcha, velistin mechakkan lemikteleh, ata achara veityeyhiv kufera techoteh, vehu ishteziv. la yada tivu deavad leh kudesha berich hu, venisa dearchish leh, bar ihu bilchodoy, havi, leose niflaot gedolot levaddo. levaddo avid veyada. veachara la yada.
1432: Ma deshailna lehane arvae, demishtakkeche tadir bechakle, i kala dechavrayay, deinnun mishtaddele beorayyta shamu. deha ribbi shimon veribbi elazar bereh, ushear chavrayyay, azlin lekamman, vela yadin minan, veshailna lehane arvae alayyhu. deyadana dekaleh derabbi shimon yargiz chaklin veturin, veinnun galu li ma dela yedana.

Ad dahavo azlin, innun arvae ahadru legabbeh. amru leh, sava sava ant shailta lan min yomin dealma, vela shailta al yoma da, dachamena tavvevha al tavvevha, chamena chamsha bene nasha yatvin, vechad sava bahadayyhu, vachamena ofe mitkannefe veka parsin gadpin al reshayyhu, illen azlin, veillen tavin, vetula la itavar meal reshayyhu. vehahu sava arim kaleh alayyhu, veinnun shamin.

Amar al da shailna. arvae arvae tehchun, vearcha da tehe metukkana kammayychu, bechol ma detivun. teren millin amartun li, dachadena behu. azlu. amru lo chavrayyay, hahu atar derabbi shimon share beh, hech anan yadin. amar lon shevoku lemare pesian divire, dehu yadrich pesioy letaman. la havi tain chamareh, vachamareh sate mearcha teren millin, veazal letaman.

Share nahik telat zimnin, nachat ribbi pinchas, amar lechavrayyay, nittakan lekabbela sevar appe yomin, dehashta yippekun legabban anpe ravreve veanpe zutere. shama rabbi shimon nahiku dachamara, amar lechavrayyay, nekum deha kala (dechedva) dechamra desava chasida ittear legabban. kam ribbi shimon vekamu chavrayyay.

Patach ribbi shimon veamar, (Tehillim 98:1) mizmor shiru laAdonai shir chadash ki niflaot asa vegomer. mizmor zakif taama leella. (shira yatma karenan lehay) amay. ella rashim taama rabba, deha ate hahu mizmor, mitattera beitra illaa leella al resheh veate zakif. man hava amar shira da. innun parot, beinnun goin dahavo gaan. (Tehillim 98:1) shiru laAdonai shir chadash. leman havo amrin shiru. lechamma retichin, lechamma memanan, lechamma dargin, dahavo atan tamman venafku lekabbela leh laarona (setam), ulehon havo amre.

Shiru laAdonai shir chadash, dechar. may tama hacha shir, umoshe amar shira, nukeba. ella hatam bemoshe arona chada (nusach acher lechuda), zot, nafkat min galuta, hi veuchelusaha, vela yattir. uvegin kach (Shemot 15:1) et hashshira hazzot, nukeba. aval hacha arona, uma dehava ganiz begavih nafik. uvegin hahu dehava ganiz begavvih, ittemar shir chadash, dechar.

Ki niflaot asa, ma deavad bappelishtim, uma deavad betaavavthon. hoshia lo yemino, leman. leatzmo. man atzmo. hahu mizmor atzmo, verucha illaa kaddisha ganiz beh. yemino, hahu deyarit sava. veda yemino, atkif behahu mizmor, vela shavik leh bida deachara.

Hacha it legallaa milla chada, kol zimna dehahu yemina, hava learchasha nisa, hava atkif behay mizmor, veshavvi leh lekammeh, leatkefa beh, keabba deatkif yemineh bechaddoy divreh lekammeh, veamar man hu deyikrav legabbe beri. kevan desarach legabbe avoy, shavvi avoy yedoy al katfoy laachora, veshadyeh bida desanoy.

Kavyachol, bekadmita ketiv, (Shemot 15:6) yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach. bakkoach man. hahu deishtemoda. bearavya korin lechadoy devar nash koach. hahu yemina nedari veatkif bechoach. man hu deyikrav legabbe beri. levatar ma ketiv, (Eicha 2:3) heshiv achor yemino mippene oyev, shavvi yemineh al kitfeh, vedache leh bida desanoy. bekadmita yemineh lekammeh bechaddoy, leatkefa beh. ulevatar laachora al katfoy, ledachyay leh. vehacha hoshia lo yemino uzeroa kadsho, teren deroin leatkefa beh.

Dei innun parot dela itregilu benissin, ella hahi shaata begoa dilhon amru shirata. da nehiku dachamara desava chasida deragil benissin, al achat kamma vechamma deamar shira. chavrayyay, i temrun dachamara la hava archeh bechach miyyoma deivre alma, puku vechamu atton debilam chayyayva, denatzchat leribbonah becholla. chamareh deribbi
1433: Pinchas ben yair al achat kamma vechamma. vetu atton devilam kad mellilat, malacha illaa hava alah milleella.

Hasheta it legallaa, chavrayyay shimu. pi haaton deivre erev shabbat ben hashshemashot, salleka bedatayychu defuma hava peticha mehahu zimna. o tenay deatne kudesha berich hu mehahu zimna. lav hachi. veraza hacha deittemsar lechakkime, dela mashgechan letippeshu delibba. pi haaton, darga deatne, hahu illaa distar nukeve. hahu hava desharya al hahu atton, umallil alah. vechad bara kudesha berich hu lehay darga, deikre pi haaton, satam leh bego (haaton) nukeba dithoma rabba, veastim aleh ad hahu zimna. kad mata hahu zimna, patach hahu nukeba, venafak veshara alah, umalilat.

Kegavvna da, (Bamidbar 16:32) vattiftach haaretz et piha. et, leasgaa duma deihu pi haaretz. et pi haaton (Bamidbar 22:28), leasgaa kamriel, deikre pi haaton. pi habbeer kegavvna da. man pi habbeer. hahu darga dehava memana aleh letatta, veihu techot pi Adonai, uman ihu. yehadriel shemeh. telat pumin illen, itberiu erev shabbat ben hashshemashot. beshaata dekodesh yoma salleka pe dimmana al kol shear pumin, uman ihu. hahu yoma deistallak veitkaddash becholla, hahu deikre pi Adonai. erev shabbat ben hashshemashot, ivrun shear pumin. itkaddash yoma salik puma deshallit al kolla pi Adonai.

Addehachi, chamu leribbi pinchas dehava ate, matu legabbeh, ata ribbi pinchas uneshakeh lerabbi shimon. amar, neshakna pi Adonai, itbassam bevusemin deginta dileh. chadu kachada, veyatvu. kevan deyatvu parchu kol innun ofin dahavo avde tula, veitbaddaru. ahdar resheh rabbi shimon, verama lon kalin veamar, ofe shemaya let attun mashgichin bikara demarechon dekaim hacha. kayymu, vela natlu midduchetayyhu, vela kerivu legabbayyhu. amar ribbi pinchas ema lon deyahachun learchayyhu, deha la yahavin lon reshu leahaddera.

Amar rabbi shimon, yedana dekudesha berich hu bae lemerchash lan nisa. ofin ofin zilu learchayychu, veamru lehahu dimmana alayychu, deha bekadmita hava birshuteh, vehasheta lav birshuteh kayyeyma. aval selikna leh leyoma detinara, kad salik iva ben sheyne takkifin, vela mitchabberan. itbaddaru innun ofe veazlu.

Addehachi, ha telat ilanin, mitpashshetan beanfin litlat sitrin alayyhu, umayayna demayya navin kammayyhu. chadu kullehu chavrayyay, vechaddu ribbi pinchas verabbi shimon. amar ribbi pinchas torach saggi hava leinnun ofe bekadmita, vetorach baale chayyim la baenan. deha (Tehillim 145:9) verachamav al kol maasav ketiv. amar rabbi shimon, ana la atrachna lon. aval i kudesha berich hu chas alan let anan yachlin ledachyay mattenan dileh. yatvu techot hahu ilana, veshatu min mayyay, veithanu tamman.

Patach ribbi pinchas veamar, (Shir HaShirim 4:15) mayan gannim beer mayim chayyim venozlim min levanon. mayan gannim, vechi let mayayn ella hahu min gannim, veha kama mayaynin tavin veyakkirin it bealma. ella let kol hanaot shavin. it mayayn denafik bemadbera, baatar yevesha, hanaa it leman deyativ veshate. aval mayayn gannim, kama ihu tav veyakkira, hahu mayayn avid tivu laasavin veevin, man dekariv aleh ithane becholla. ithane bemayya, ithane baasavin, ithane beevin. hahu mayayn mitattera becholla. kama vevradin, kamma asavin derecha sacharaneh, kamma yaut hahu mayayn, mishshear mayaynin, beer mayim chayyim.

Vehachi okimna kolla bichneset yisrael kaamar, ihi mayayn gannim. man gannim. chamesh gannim it leh lekudesha berich hu, deka mishtashea behu. umayayna chada ilavavyyhu, deka ashke lon, veravvi lon, tamir veganiz, vechullehu avdin perin veevin. ginta chada it letatta minnayyhu, vehahu ginta natir sachra mikkol sitrin dealma. techot hay ginta, it gannim acharanin, avdin evin liznnayyhu.
Vehay ginta, ithappach vahavi mayayn deashke lon, beer mayim chayyim, kad itzterich havi mayayn, vechad itzterich havi beer, ma ben hay lehay. la dame, kad itmashshechun
1434: Mayya mielayyhu, lechad shaavin mayya leashkaa. venozlim min levanon, may nozlim. illen nozlim ahadru lemayayn, (sefer acher dechullehu) kad navin mayin venozlim tippin leella (sefer acher milleella) illen batar illen, mayin metikan, denafsha azla abbatrayyhu. kach innun chamesh mekorin, denafku min levanon, itavidu nozlim behay mayayn. kach kudesha berich hu rachish lan nisa baatar da, karenna al mayayna da kera da. (sefer acher may nozlim. illen chamesh mekorin denafku min levanon leella, itavidu nozlim dechad ahadru lameayyn, navin mayin venozlim tippin illen batar illen mayin metikan, denafsha azla avatrayyhu. kach kudesha berich hu racheysh lan nissa baatar da, behay meayyen veal mayayna da karena kera da.)

Tu patach veamar, (Devarim 20:19) ki tatzur el ir yamim rabbim lehillachem aleha letafsa vegomer, kama tavin innun archin ushevilin deorayyta, deha bechol milla umilla, it kamma etin, kama tavin livne nasha, kama margelan deka menaharan lechol setar, velet lach milla beorayyta, delet bah kama butzinin menaharan lechol setar. hay kera ihu kefum peshateh. veit beh kefum midrasheh. veit beh chachmeta illaa, leizdahara leman deitzterich. zakkaa chulakeh man deishtedal beorayyta tadir.

Man deishtedal bah, ma ketiv beh, (Tehillim 1:2-3) ki im betorat Adonai cheftzo uvetorato yehge yomam valayla, vehaya keetz. amay da samich leda. ella man deishtedal beorayyta yomam valayla, la lihevi keaa yevesha, ella keetz shatul al palge mayim. ma ilan it beh sharashin, veit beh kelippin, veit beh mocha, veit beh anfin, veit beh tarpin, veit beh parchin, veit beh ibba. shivat zinin illen, sallekin leshiva asar, leshivin. uf millin deorayyta it behu peshata dikra. derasha. remez, deka ramiz chachmeta. gimatriyayot. razin temirin. razin setimin illen al illen. pasul vechasher. tame vetahor. isur vehetter. mikkan ulehala, mitpashshetaan anfin lechol setar. vehaya keetz vadday, vei lav, lav ihu chacham bechachmeta.

Ta chaze, kama chavivin innun demishtaddele beorayyta kamme kudesha berich hu, deafillu bezimna dedina talya bealma, veityeyhiv reshu limchabbela lechabbela, kudesha berich hu pakid leh ilavavyyhu, al innun deka mishtaddele beorayyta. vehachi amar leh kudesha berich hu, ki tatzur el ir, begin chovehon saggiin dechattan lekammay, veitchayyeyvu bedina. yamim rabbim, may rabbim. (telata yoma, da batar da, ikre yamim rabbim, uf hacha ki tatzur al ir, yamim rabbim) telata yomin, da batar da, deishtemoda dever bemata. menalan deyamim rabbim telata yomin innun, dichtiv, (Vayikra 15:25) veishsha ki yazuv zov damah yamim rabbim. vechi yamim rabbim innun. ella telata yomin da batar da, ikre yamim rabbim. uf hachi ki tatzur el ir yamim rabbim, telata yomin da batar da, deishtemoda dever bemata. ta veafkid lach al (kol) bene beti. lo tashchit et etzah, da talmid chacham deihu bemata, deihu ilana dechayye, ilana deyahiv ivin.

Davar acher et etzah, hahu deyahiv eta lemata, leishtezava min dina, veolif lon archa deyahachun bah, veal da lo tashchit et etzah lindoach alav garzen, lenadcha aleh dina, vela leoshata aleh charba melahata, charba meshannana, hahi dekatla lishar inshe dealma. ki mimmennu tochel. vechi hahu mechabbela achil minneh, la. ella ki mimmennu tochel, hahi tinra takkifa, hahi dechol ruchin takkifin vekaddishin nafkin minnah, delet hanaa vetiuveta leruach kudesha behay alma, ella orayyta dehahu zakkaa, kivyachol ihu mefarnes lah, veyahev lah mezona behay alma, yattir mikkol karbenin dealma.

Bekarban ma ketiv. (Shir HaShirim Adonai:1) achalti yari im divshi ichlu reim. umiyyoma deitcharav be makdesha, uvatlu karbenin, let leh lekudesha berich hu, ella innun millin deorayyta, veorayyta deitchaddesha befumeh, begin kach ki mimmennu tochel, velet lah mezona behay alma, ella mimmennu, umeinnun dichvavteh. vechevan demimmennu tochel, veihu zan lah, oto lo tichrot, havi (tamir) zahir beh, dela tikrav beh.
1435: Etz hassade, da ikre adam deishtemoda ella vetatta. etz hassade, ilana ravreva vetakkif dehahu (Bereshit 27:27) sade asher beracho Adonai. (da) samich aleh, ilan deishtemoda lehahu sade tadir. lavo mippanecha bammatzor, milla da ahdar leresha dikra, dichtiv lo tashchit et etzah, hahu deyahiv lon eta, veatkin lemata, lavo mippanecha bammatzor, ihu yahiv lon eta, leittakna uleahadra betiyyuveta, veatkin leh mane zayynin, bukinas veshofarin. lavo mippanecha, may lavo mippanecha. lavo lekammay, uleaala mippanecha. mikkamme dechilu dilach. bammatzor, baatar deillain vetattain la yachlin leaala tamman. uman ihu. darga devaale teshuva alin tamman, uman ihu. teshuva. da ihu matzor, atar takkif, vetinnara takkifa.

Vechevan deeta da natlin, ana mechapper lechovayyhu veitkabbelan beraava lekammay. vechol da pakid kudesha berich hu, al innun demishtaddele beorayyta. begin kach zakkain innun deka mishtaddele beorayyta, innun demishtaddele beorayyta innun ilanin ravrevin behay alma.

Chamu, ma avad kudesha berich hu denata illen ilanin, zakkaa archa da, vela day ilana chada, ella telata ilanin ravrevin, perisan anfin lechol setar, avad lan kudesha berich hu. yehe raava kamme shemaya, dela yitadun lealma ilanin illen, veda mayayna, meatar da vead yoma kayymin tamman, vehahu maayyna demayya. ukeran lon bene nasha, netzivu deribbi pinchas ben yair. (ad kan) (chaser vezehu)

Patach rabbi shimon veamar, (Bereshit 33:5) vayyissa et enav vayyar et hannashim veet hayeladim vayyomer mi elle lach vayyomar hayeladim asher chanan elohim et avdecha. ta chaze, hahu rasha deesav, yahiv enoy leayyeyna al nashin, uvegineh atkin tikunoy. yaakov, shavvi shefachot bekadmita, uvenehon levatar, dechashivu yattir. lea abbatrayyhu, uvenaha levatar. levatar yosef, uvatra rachel, vehu avar lifnehem.

Kad segidu kullehon, ma ketiv. (Bereshit 33:6) vattiggashna hashshefachot henna veyaldehen vattishtachavina. ulevatar ketiv, vattiggash gam lea viladeha veyishtachavu veachar niggash yosef verachel vegomer. veha yosef levatrayyta hava, verachel lekammeh. ella bera tava, bera rechima, tzaddika dealma, yosef, kevan dechama eneh dehahu rasha mistakkal benashin, dachil al immeh, nafik meabbatrah, ufaris derooy vegufeh, vechasse alah, begin dela yitten hahu rasha enoy beimmeh. kamma itsege, shit ammin lechol setar, vechafa alah, vela yachil eneh dehahu rasha leshalletaa alah.

Kegavvna da, vayyissa bilam et enav, eno ketiv, hahu ena bisha (teren ayynin have zakif, ella beshaata) debaa leistakkela alayyhu. vayyar et yisrael shochen lishvatav. mahu shochen lishvatav. ella shivta deyosef hava tamman, veshivta devinyamin. shivta deyosef, dela shalta behu ena bisha, dichtiv, (Bereshit 49:22) ben porat yosef. man ben porat. deitsege lechassaa al immeh. ben porat ale ayin, dela shalta beh ena bisha. shivta devinyamin, dichtiv beh (Devarim 33:12) uven ketefav shachen. uchetiv (Devarim 33:12) yishkon lavetach. may lavetach. dela dachil meena bisha, vela dachil mippegain bishin.

Amar hahu rasha, ana abar shura da, dela itkeyyaym, vaana istakkal kaddeka yaut. rachel havat tamman, chamat deena dehahu rasha meshannena leavasha, ma avdat. nafkat uferishat gadfaha alayyhu, vechafat al beraha. hada hu dichtiv vayyissa vilam et enav vayyar et yisrael. kevan dechama ruach dekudesha, ena meshannena, miyyad vattehi alav ruach elohim. al man. al yisrael. defaris gadpoy, vechappa alehon. umiyyad tav hahu rasha laachora.

Bekadmita bera chafa al imeh. vehasheta imma chafat al bera. amar kudesha berich hu, behahi shaata dechafa ihu al rachel immeh, dela yishlot ena dehahu rasha alah, chayyecha, beshaata deyete ena bisha achara leistakkela al banecha veal benay, immach techappe alayyhu. at chappit al immach, immach techappe alayyhu. at chappit al immach, immach techappe alach.

Vayyissa et enav vayyar et hannashim. hay kera, beraza dechachmeta ittemar, beyoma dechippure, divne alma kayyme bedina, veyisrael tayyvin betiyyuveta kamme kudesha berich hu, lechappera al chovayyhu. vehahu mekatrega kayyeyma alayyhu, dechashiv leovada lon al chovayyhu, shalche leh hahu dorona, ucheden ketiv, (Bereshit 33) ki amar achappera fanav bammincha haholechet lefanay. levatar dimkabbel hahu mekatrega lehahu dorona, ithappach lehu sannegora.
Zakif vechame lon leyisrael, kullehu mitanan betaanita, yechefe raglin. chame nashin, chame yannukin, kullehu betaanita, kullehu
1436: Nekiyyim benakyu. vayyomer mi elle lach. shema kaddisha lach. mi elle lach. shail al yannuke, veamar hayeladim asher chanan elohim et avdecha. vechi amay itzterich leatava leh kelum. ella kevan dimkabbel hahu shochad, ithappach lehu sanegor. zakif enoy, vechame lon leyisrael kegavvna da, chashiv divgin dechilu dileh innun kayymin kach.

Shail al yannuke, veamar mi elle lach. (veamar beorach satim hayeladim) mahu mi elle lach. ella amar, tinach attun dechavtun kamme malka. aval illen yannuke, amay kayymin hachi, mi elle lach. vayyomar hayeladim, ruach kudsha amar, veal da zakif taama. vayyomar hayeladim. beorach satim asher chanan elohim et avdecha, vechi ruach hakkodesh amar et avdecha. ella ruach kudsha amar, illen innun yannuke dela chavu, vela taimu taama decheta, umasar lon kudesha berich hu, bida dehahu memana dilach, vekatil lon bela chova, kema deat amer (Kohelet 4:1) umiyyad oshkehem koach. veda hu et avdecha.

Kevan deshama meinnun yannuke, miyyad salik legabbe kudesha berich hu, veamar, mareh dealma, kol archach bedina dikshot, vei dina sharya al yisrael begin chovehon ihu, yannukin dilhon dela chavu lekamach, amay masrat lon lekatla lon bela chova. vekudesha berich hu natil milloy bechach, vechas alayyhu. vehahi shaata, la havi askara battinokot.

Vehahu mekatrega natil kina mehahu memana ditchot yedeh. amar, vechi li yahiv kudesha berich hu innun demitlabbeshan bechetin vechovin, ulehahu memana dili masar yannukin bela chova, dela taamun taama dechova. miyyad azal leappaka lon mittechot yedeh, vela yishlot behu. veal da akdim leh veamar leh, hayeladim asher chanan elohim et avdecha. lehahu avdecha, bela chova uvela chattaa. uvegin dela yehe shevacha lammemana dileh yattir minneh, baa leappaka lon min yedoy.

Kad sallekin tzelotin deyisrael beyoma da kamme kudesha berich hu, ma ketiv (Bereshit 33:3) vehu avar lifnehem. ha ruach kudesha abar lekamayyhu, (kema deat amar 1 vayyaavor malkam lifnehem) vehu vadday avar lifnehem. vayishtachu artza sheva peamim, ruach kudesha, azar garmeh legabbe ella 7 zimnin, legabbe 7 dargin illain dealeh, veaktin garmeh, leachlela lon immeh kol chad vechad. ad gishto ad achiv, lehahu darga derachame, deha ben uvat innun. ben, (Shemot 4) beni vechori yisrael. bat, keneset yisrael. ruach kudesha avid aziru degarmeh, ad gishto.

Kevan demata legabbeh, tava mineh, veoda leh tzaara divnayyhu letatta. vetarvavyyhu alin lehechala temira geniza deyom hakkippurim, imma dilhon, vetavin al yisrael lechappera lon, keden ketiv (Vayikra 16:30) ki vayom hazze yechapper alechem letaher etchem vegomer. achapper alechem la ketiv, ella yechapper alechem.

Vehasheta hayeladim, illen chakkimin dehacha, kudesha berich hu yahav lon razin deorayyta, leitattera behu, uleishtachllela (nusach acher uleishtaddela) behu. ena bisha la shalta alayyhu, begin ena tava, ruach kudesha deribbi pinchas, desharya alayyhu. ata ribbi pinchas uneshakeh. amar, ilmale la atena archa da, ella lemishma millin illen, day li. zakkaa archa da deatena legabbach.

Vekudesha berich hu hacha, deistakkam immana. vela day ilana chad, ella telat. aval mayayna da, diyyukena illaa hu, legabbe hahu mayayna detamir veganiz. telat ilanin illen, telat arazin innun, deikrun arze levanon. veinnun diyyukena ditlat ilanin ravrevin, raza daavahan. (sefer acher daasatekam immana. mayayna da, diyyukena dehahu mayayna ena illaa detamir veganiz. telat ilanin illen inun diyyukena ditlat ilanin ravrevin, raza deavahan.) zakkaa chulakana behahi shaata.

Arkinu ilanin, chad al resheh deribbi shimon, vechad al resheh deribbi pinchas, vechad al resheh deribbi elazar. itpeshatu anfin, lechol setar, al reshehon dechavrayyay, bacha (nusach acher chadde) ribbi pinchas veamar, zakkaa chulaki vezakkain enay dechaman kach. vela al didach veal didi chaddena bilchodayyhu, ella al ribbi elazar berana ka chaddena, dechashiv ihu kamme malka kaddisha kechad minan. kam uneshakeh. amar ribbi shimon, elazar kum bekiyyumach, veema lekamme marach millin dileh. kam ribbi elazar.
1437: Patach veamar (Micha 6:Adonai) ammi zechar na ma yaatz balak melech moav vegomer. ammi, kama kudesha berich hu abba rachaman al benoy, af al gav dechavu gabbeh, kol milloy birchimu legabbayyhu, keabba legabbe bereh. chate bereh legabbe avoy, alke leh, kol kach dealke leh la tav mearcheh, nazif beh bemillin vela kabbil. amar avoy, la baena lemebad livri kema deavedna ad yoma. illu alkeyeh yehe chashish beresheh, ha keibba dileh gabbay, ehe nazif beh, ha diyyukeneh mishtanya, ma abid, ella ezil veetchannen legabbeh, veema leh millin rechichin, begin dela yitatzev.

Ken bechol zinin, azil kudesha berich hu beyisrael. share immehon alkaa vela kabbilu. nazif behu, vela kabbilu. amar kudesha berich hu, chamena bivri, divgin malkiyyuta delakena lon, innun chashshu bereshehon. vavy, deha miggo keibba dilhon, chashishna ana. dichtiv, (yeshaya 63) bechol tzaratam lo tzar. nazifna behu, eshtanna diyyukena dilhon, dichtiv, (Eicha 4:8) chashach mishshechor tooram lo nikkeru bachutzot. vavy kad istekalit behu, vela ishtemodau. hasheta, ehe mitchanena legabbayyhu go tachanunim. ammi me asiti lach uma heleticha. beri yechidaa dili, chaviva denafshay, chame ma avadit lach, shalitit lach al kol bene hechale, shalitit lach al kol malchin dealma, vei avadit lach ovadin acharanin, ane bi, annet havi sahid bi.

Ammi zechar na ma yaatz balak melech moav ume ana oto bilam ben beor. zechar na, havi dachir bematu minach. ma yaatz hasheta it leistakkela, ma hava eta devalak al amma kaddisha (chaser kan) veorayyta la chashivat leh levalak kelum, kema dehava lelavan, dichtiv, (Devarim 26:5) arammi oved avi. (shayych parashat shalach lecha daf 161 amud bet 40 hammatchil da im da)

Ashurennu vegomer, tziyyura udeyyukena daavoy, itreshim beh mammash. umehahu zimna dehava bimaha deimmeh, missitra dilah, itmetach veoshit pesia levar yattir. ki merosh tzurim erennu, da diyyukena vetziyyura daavoy (mammash). kevan dehava bimaha deimmeh, ashurennu, oshit pesia levar, kegavvna da 400 (nusach acher 6).

Veda hu umiggevaot ashurennu, bimtivta illaa, gevaot chaser 6. (rammaa decholla hahi illaa decholla) bimtivta dirkia, umiggevaot beat 6. veashlim litren sitrin. chad, deha hay givat la itparsha min berah lealmin, vela shavkat leh. veal da itkelil 6 bahadah lealam. vechad, deha giva diltatta berah deitkelil bah, itzterich lezimna deate kad yete malka meshicha, lenatla leh givat illaa, uleaala leh go gadfaha, begin leatkefa leh, uleokama leh bachayyin illain, uminah yippuk behahu yoma meshicha dedavid.

Veraza da, (Tehillim 2:7) asappera el chok Adonai amar elay beni atta ani hayyom yelidticha. zammin ana lomar lehahu atar deikre chok, ulevassera leh, (Adonai amar elay bene atta ani hayyom yelidticha). behahu yoma mammash, yappik leh hahu chok mittechot gadfaha, bechamma chayyin, bechamma itrin, bechamma birchan, kaddeka yaut.

Vehahu chok la yishtear bilchodoy, yitkelil beh meshicha achara bereh deyosef, vetamman yittakaf, vela baatar achara. uvegin deihu giva tattaa, delet bah chayyin, yamut mashiach da, veyitketil, vihe mit ad detilkot chayyin giva da, mehahi giva illaa, veyikum.

Uvegin kach, bimtivta dirkia umiggevaot shelim beot 6, al teren sitrin illen (ketiv). aval bimtivta illaa, chaser, bela 6, leachazaa milla delet bah kusheya vesafek. hen am levadad yishkon, beyichuda, bela irbuveya achara.

Kol yichuda shelim, hacha ihu. Adonai elohenu Adonai. deha raza dileh, merosh tzurim ihu, veityayched beresha, begiza ushevila. Adonai: da resha illaa, avira desalleka. elohenu: da giza, deittemar (Yeshayahu 11:1) geza yishay. Adonai: da shevila diltatta. veal raza da ityaychad beh kaddeka yaut. uvegin deitmetach beh shevila itzterich (kan chaser). raza deitgezar bitre metivte.
Zakkaa chulakach ribbi shimon, dezachit lemillin illain demarich, umarach itree bach, kamma shiura dimtichan dishvila da beshiura illaa, deresha
1438: Vegiza ushevila, veitlabbeshan bimtichu da. (nusach acher veal da mateychev deechad, shiura deshit sitrin. vecholla ityachad behay et 4 ach 4), veal da metichu de (nusach acher Adonai) shiura deshit sitrin. vecholla ityachad behay at (nusach acher ach) uvegin kach, levadad yishkon kaddeka yaut.

Uvaggoyim lo yitchashshav, yisrael it lon ketav velashon. uvechol at, yachlin leistakkela bediyyukena vetziyyura kaddeka yaut. aval baggoyim ovde kochavim umazzalot, lo yitchashshav. raza dena, begin delet lon ketav velashon, velet lon leistakkela uleminda kelum, deha (Yirmeyahu 10:15) hevel hemma maase tatuim. vela yitchashav raza dena bemachashava uveastakkeluta dilhon, hoil velet lon ketav. zakkain innun yisrael.

Mi mana afar yaakov umispar et rova yisrael. (mi) hahu nekuda illaa, resha vegiza ushevila, bitmiru ihu, vela kayyeyma leshaala levar. aval mishshaatta deshari leitbanaa, ulemebad hechala biruteh, veikre mi, share leitbanaa, diyyukena, dileh mammash. afik nukeba dileh, bediyyukena deimmeh.

May mi. da resha vegiza ushevila. (10) veitpashshat leitbanaa bifshitu dechad hechala, litren sitrin bane. veaf al gav deappik leyisrael. deihu 6, uf hachi appik lenukeba dileh kachada, veazmenah legabbeh. mana, kema deat amer (Daniel 1:Adonai) vayman lahem hammelech (Ester 9:19) umishloach manot. yahav leh nevazbeza rav veyakkira, veappik lah kachada minneh. behahu peshitu deitpeshat appik tarvavyyhu kachada, (kegavvna da pashut lehacha valehakea, appik bara uveratta beriga chada, veal da shamayim vaaretz beriga chada itberiu kachada) beshaata chada.

Umispar et rova yisrael, rova yisrael raza da beginach Rabbi itmesar, zakkaa chulakach. rova yisrael, reviit, min medidu deyisrael, ihu berit. amay ikre rova. ella shiura degufa arba beritot havi beshiura dileh. uverit rova ihu beshiura dimdidu degufa. kolla appik mi. (ad kan)

Ribbi elazar hava azil lemechome leribbi yose chamuy, ribbi abba vechavroy azlu immeh. patach ribbi elazar veamar, (Tehillim Adonai:4) Adonai boker tishma koli vegomer. Adonai boker may boker. ella da boker deavraham, deittear bealma. dichtiv, (Bereshit 22:3) vayyashkem avraham babboker. deha kad ate tzafra, hahu boker ittear bealma, vehu iddan raava lecholla, ulemebad tivu lechol alma, lezakkain ulechayayvin. ucheden iddan tzelota hu, limtzele kamme malka kaddisha.

Veal da, beshaata deate tzafra, kol innun asire malka, ashkachu nayycha, iddan tzelota ihu alayyhu. vekol shekken innun detayyvin betiyyuveta, uvaan bautehon lekamme malka kaddisha. begin, dehai shaata, chad memana nafik listar darom, urefael shemeh, vechol zine asvevta bidoy. umistar darom, nafak chad rucha, umati legabbe hahu memana, dimmana al asvavta. vechad mate tzelota lekamme kudesha berich hu, pakid leve dina dileh, dela yiftechun bedina, begin dechayyim bida dekudesha berich hu, vela bidehon.

Umiggo deihu iddan raava, baa kudesha berich hu zechuta dehahu bar nash, i yishtekach bitzlota, (yeot, vei lo chashiv leh beshogeg) o deihu mareh detiuveta, chas aleh. (197 amud bet) behahi shaata kal tzipparin dimkannan ishtemau, dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:17) asher sham tzipporim yekannenu. veinnun tzipporin odan umeshabbechan lekudesha berich hu. vehahu ayyelet hashshachar ittear bealma veamar, (Tehillim 31:20) ma rav tuvecha asher tzafanta lireecha vegomer. keden hahu memana nafik, veavid kol ma deitpekad.

Vei tema dezine asvavta bidoy kema deamaran. lav hachi. deha asvavta la havi, ella bidoy demalka kaddisha. aval beshaata defakid kudesha berich hu asvavta lehahu bar nash, ihu nafik, vechol innun mekatregin dimmanan al marin bishin, dachalin minneh. keden hahu rucha deka nasa missitra dedarom, oshit leh lehahu bar nash, veha asvavta ishtechach, vecholla bidoy dekudesha berich hu.

Veal da ketiv, Adonai boker tishma koli. vela ketiv Adonai babboker tishma koli. ella legabbe boker deavraham kaamar. (Tehillim Adonai:4) boker eerach lecha vaatzappe. tere boker amay. ella chad boker deavraham. vechad boker deyosef. dichtiv, (Bereshit 44:3) habboker or, umetargeminan tzafra
1439: Nahir, nahir vadday. eerach lecha vaatzappe, eerach lecha mahu. ella asadder lecha butzina dilach leadlaka. kema deat amer (Tehillim 132:17) arachti ner limshichi. ulegabbe boker deyosef kaamar, dehahu siddura devutzina dileh hu.

Vaatzappe, mahu vaatzappe. ha kol bene alma metzappan umechakkan letivu dekudesha berich hu, veafilu beire dechakla, uma shevacha dedavid yattir mikkol bene alma, ela, milla da shailna, vehachi amru li, veihi milla keshot deate merachik. nehora kadmaa devara kudesha berich hu, hava nahir ad dela havo yachlin almin lemisbeleh. ma avad kudesha berich hu, aved nehora linhoreh, leitlabbesha da beda. vechen kol shear nehorin, ad dealmin kullehu itkayyaymu bekiyyumayyhu, veyachlin lemisbal.

Uvegin kach itpeshshatu dargin, veitlabbashu nehorin, veinnun ikrun kenafayim illain, ad dematu lehay boker deyosef, veihu natil kol nehorin illain, umiggo dechol nehorin illain beh talyayn, zivih salik missayyfe alma ad sayyfe alma dilella, ad dealmin diltatta la yachlin lemisbal. ata david veatkan hay butzina, chuppaa lehay boker deyosef, leitchappaa beh, ulekayyeyma almin diltatta, besiddura devutzina da veal da ketiv, boker eerach lecha vaatzappe. kema deat amer, (Shemot 37:2) vaytzappehu zahav tahor. (nusach acher uvegin dehahu butzina david beh talyay vechulei) begin dehahu butzina dedavid ihi, uvah talyay, amar deihu lihevi chuppaa lehay boker. ata ribbi abba uneshakeh, amar ilmale la nafakna bearcha, ella lemishma milla da dayi.

Ad dahavo azle, ha yona chad mata legabbe ribbi elazar. sheriat, veka metzaftzefa kammeh. amar ribbi elazar, yona keshera mehemnat havit tadir bishlichutich, zili veema leh, ha chavrayyay atan legabbach, vaana immehon. venisa yitrechish leh litlata yomin, vela yinpol aleh dechilu, deha bechedva anan azlin legabbeh. ativ zimna achara veamar, la chaddena saggeya, uvaish beenay saggi, al chad rimmona malya deityehiv techoteh, veyose shemeh. azlat hahi yona mikkammeh, veinnun chavrayyay azlu.

Amar ribbi abba leribbi elazar, may hay, tavvavhna saggi, mimma dachamena. amar leh, yona da atat legabbay bishlichuteh deribbi yose chame, deihu beve mareh, veyadana mehay yona deishteziv, vechillufa ityeyhiv aleh veitsse.

Ad dahavo azlu, ha ureva chad kaim lekammayyhu, kara bechela, umetzaftzefa tziftzufa saggi. amar ribbi elazar, lehachi at kayyeyma, ulehachi annet mitakken, zil learchach, deha yedana. amar ribbi elazar, chavrayyay nezil venigmol chesed lerimona, dehava malya mikkolla, veribbi yose difkiin shemeh ihu, deha istallak mealma den, velet man dechaze leishtaddela beh, veihu kariv legabban.

Satu mearcha, veazlu letaman. kevan dechamu lon kol bene mata, nafku legabbayyhu. vealu tamman beve ribbi yose difkiin, innun chavrayyay illen. bera zeera hava leh leribbi yose, vela shavik levar nash deyimte learsa daavoy, batar demit. ella hu bilchodoy hava samich leh, uvache aleh, pumeh befumeh mitdabbeka.

Patach hahu yannuka veamar, mareh dealma, ketiv beorayyta, (Devarim 22:6) ki yikkare kan tzippor lefanecha vegomer, shalleach teshallach et haem vegomer. hava gae hahu yannuka uvache, amar, mareh dealma, kayyem milla da deorayyta, teren benin havina meabba veimmi, ana vaachoti zeerta minnay. hava lach lemesav lan, ulekayyeyma milla deorayyta. vei tema mareh dealma, em ketiv, vela av, ha hacha kolla hu, abba veimma. imma mitat, unesivat lah meal benin. hasheta abba dehavi chappe alan, insiv meal benin, an dina deorayyta. bachu ribbi elazar vechavrayyay, lokovel bichya vegau dehahu yannuka.

Patach ribbi elazar veamar, (Mishlei 25:3) shamayim larum vaaretz laomek vegomer. ad dehava amar ribbi elazar kera da, hava ammuda deeshsha pasik benayyhu, vehahu yannuka hava davik befumeh daavoy, vela havo mitparshan. amar ribbi elazar, o bae kudesha berich hu lemirchash nisa, o bae dela yishtedal bar nash achara aleh, aval al millin dehahu yannuka vedimoy, la yachilna lemisbal.
